chronicles-of-arithmos.assessmentNote: Landing page and manifest.json: 'Educational 2D Math RPG Game for Primary Students' — solve math problems to cast spells, adaptive difficulty, multiplayer room codes; game data 145 maps / 2784 events / 6665 dialogue lines with region unlocks (Forest, Goblin Camp, Ancient Pyramid, Tundra Town, Volcano Outpost) and Demon Lord / Numeromancer defeated switches (one map file, Map113, failed to fetch once and was not needed for the verdict); no Steam/itch/reviews/media; GitHub 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 2.

translatedTitles.ja: クロニクルズ・オブ・アリトモス

zh-Hans.summary: 面向小学生的 2D 数学教育 RPG：解出数学题即可施法、防御或攻击怪物，难度自适应，还能与同学联机解题。

en.summary: An educational 2D math RPG for primary students: solving math problems casts spells, shields or attacks, with adaptive difficulty and multiplayer room codes for classmates.

ja.summary: 小学生向けの教育系2D数学RPG。計算問題を解くと魔法や攻撃が発動し、難易度が自動調整され、クラスメイトと協力プレイもできる。

chronicles-of-the-sacred-kouign-amann.assessmentNote: No README or external trace (0 stars); game data 3 maps / 53 events / 113 French dialogue lines — a small but real Episode I beta (cliff + cave + credits) with a complete French opening monologue (tyrant Custard VI, the MDRCB stealing the kouign-amann recipe, four adventurers promised knighthood); KwiɲaˈMɑ̃n is a phonetic spelling of kouign-amann; rating blank; popularity 2.

translatedTitles.ja: 聖なるクイニアマンのクロニクル

zh-Hans.summary: 法式喜剧 RPG（第 1 集 Beta）：Crèmelune 王国，暴君治下，kouign-amann（布列塔尼黄油蛋糕）原始食谱被盗，四位冒险者奉命找回圣羊皮纸。

en.summary: A French comedy RPG (Episode I beta): in the kingdom of Crèmelune, under a tyrant king, the original kouign-amann recipe has been stolen, and four young adventurers are ordered to retrieve the sacred parchment.

ja.summary: フランス風コメディRPG（エピソードIベータ版）。クレームリューヌ王国で、暴君の治世下、クイニアマン（ブルターニュのバターケーキ）の原レシピが盗まれ、4人の若き冒険者が聖なる羊皮紙の奪還を命じられる。

tsugunohi.assessmentNote: This fork is a Vietnamese-titled re-upload of ImCyan's Tsugunohi train episode (the 2012 free version: 5 days + ending, picture-driven, only 6 text dialogue lines by design); all switches/variables/debug text remain in Japanese; title-screen picture title_terop_1.png carries a Vietnamese warning ('LƯU Ý — ĐÂY LÀ GAME KINH DỊ CÂN NHẮC TRƯỚC KHI CHƠI') while scene pictures are the Japanese originals, so languages are corrected from the old meta's [vi] to [vi, ja]; popularity scores the GAME, not this fork: the original has a Steam collection (9 stories, free), TapTap 6.0/10 (only 3 ratings), GameLoop 4.2 (8864 ratings) and 150M+ related video views, so popularity 6; this fork itself has 1 star and no external discussion; rating stays blank (no serious review evidence).

zh-Hans.summary: ImCyan 的极简日式恐怖短篇（电车篇）：少女连续五天乘电车通勤，车厢里的乘客与景象一天比一天诡异；本条目为越南语标题的转贴版本，标题画面含越南语警告，场景图为日文原作素材。

en.summary: ImCyan's minimalist Japanese horror short (the train episode): a girl commutes by train for five days as the passengers and scenery grow stranger each day; this entry is a Vietnamese-titled re-upload — its title screen carries a Vietnamese warning while the scene pictures are the Japanese originals.

ja.summary: ImCyanによる極簡日式ホラー短編（電車編）。少女が5日間電車で通勤するなか、車内の乗客や風景が日を追うごとに異様になっていく。本エントリはベトナム語タイトルの転載版で、タイトル画面にはベトナム語の警告があり、シーン画像は日本語の原作素材である。

skazka.assessmentNote: No README or external trace (0 stars); game data 51 maps / 433 events / 264 dialogue lines with quest switches (Quest1/QUEST1COMPLETE/QUEST2) and a DEMO switch, so contentType demo; СКАЗКА is Russian for 'fairy tale', CKA3KA is its look-alike Latin spelling; NOT the unrelated Steam game SKAZKA (KuKo / Mustella Games, App 1815400); Map041 'Комната траха' holds only 14 identical 'Вы получили 50 говна' (you got 50 shit) events — a crude joke currency farm, no sexual content, so nsfw stays false; rating blank; popularity 2.

zh-Hans.summary: 俄语 RPG Maker 喜剧/恐怖 RPG（demo）：中学生 Рома 从家出发，穿过森林与学校、马桶世界与噩梦，走向城堡；含任务系统与多名同伴。

en.summary: A Russian RPG Maker comedy/horror RPG (demo): Roma, a schoolboy, travels from home through the forest and school, the toilet world and nightmares, toward the castle, with a quest system and several companions.

ja.summary: ロシア語のツクール製コメディ／ホラーRPG（デモ版）。中学生ローマが家を出発し、森や学校、トイレの世界や悪夢を越えて城を目指す。クエストシステムと複数の仲間がいる。

coders-bizarre-adventure.assessmentNote: No external trace (web search only finds unrelated JoJo games); game data 13 maps / 484 events / 217 Chinese dialogue lines with coloured-ball puzzle switches, slime encounters and seal collecting; dialogue is Chinese — the only English-looking lines are an Atari Adventure easter egg ('Created By Warren Robinett') and code fragments, so languages are corrected from the old meta's [en, zh-Hans] to [zh-Hans]; MSC-CQU is Chongqing University's Microsoft Student Club (listed in the university's 2020-2021 society register); rating blank; popularity 2.

translatedTitles.ja: コーダーズ・ビザール・アドベンチャー

zh-Hans.summary: 重庆大学微软学生俱乐部制作的中文解谜冒险游戏：穿越茶馆、迷宫、木屋与梦境等 13 张地图，解开彩球机关、躲避史莱姆、收集封印，途中还藏有致敬雅达利《Adventure》的彩蛋；一句对白写明更多内容正在开发中。

en.summary: A Chinese puzzle-adventure by the Microsoft Student Club of Chongqing University: cross 13 maps — a teahouse, a maze, a cabin and a dream world — solving coloured-ball switches, dodging slimes and collecting seals, with an easter egg honouring Atari's Adventure; one line notes more content is in development.

ja.summary: 重慶大学マイクロソフト学生クラブによる中国語パズルアドベンチャー。茶館、迷路、小屋、夢の世界など13のマップを巡り、色玉の仕掛けを解き、スライムを避け、封印を集める。アタリの『Adventure』へのイースターエッグもあり、さらなるコンテンツ開発中の旨の台詞もある。

cold-front.assessmentNote: itch.io official page: rating 4.8 from 1559 ratings, 534 comments, 45 min-1 hr, 2 endings, fan translations in KR/ESP/pt-BR/zh-CN/RUS; Fandom wiki, TV Tropes and Kotaku listings plus a Gravenox Horror Gaming review; made in 25 days for a Korean RPG Maker jam, released 2022-08-03; this fork's data matches the original exactly (Augustine/Winnie, elk/bear monster, snowman, car scenes, 2 ending switches, 7007 English dialogue lines; Korean only in map/switch names); rating 9, popularity 7.

zh-Hans.summary: RachelDrawsThis 与 STUDIO INVESTIGRAVE 的短篇恐怖叙事游戏（2022 年韩国 RPG Maker 限时创作，25 天完成）：发小 Augustine 与 Winnie 在七月驾车出游时被突如其来的暴风雪困住，友情、嫉妒与悔恨在风雪中浮现；约 45 分钟至 1 小时，双结局。本条目为英文版转贴，韩语只存在于编辑器地图名中。

en.summary: A short horror narrative game by RachelDrawsThis and STUDIO INVESTIGRAVE, made in 25 days for a Korean RPG Maker jam (released 2022-08-03): childhood friends Augustine and Winnie are trapped in a sudden blizzard on a July drive, and friendship, jealousy and regret surface in the snow; 45 minutes to an hour, two endings. This entry is an English re-upload — Korean survives only in the editor's map names.

ja.summary: RachelDrawsThisとSTUDIO INVESTIGRAVEによる短編ホラーナラティブゲーム（2022年韓国のRPGツクールジャム向けに25日間で制作、2022年8月3日公開）。幼なじみのオーガスティンとウィニーは7月のドライブ中に突然の吹雪に閉じ込められ、友情、嫉妬、後悔が雪の中で浮かび上がる。45分〜1時間、2エンディング。本エントリは英語版の転載で、韓国語はエディタのマップ名にのみ残っている。

college-live.assessmentNote: No external trace (web search only finds the unrelated adult game 'College Life' by MikeMasters — a different game, do not confuse); game data 7 maps / 58 events / 72 Indonesian dialogue lines (prologue, kos rental, campus, card-gambling switches Judi / Dealer Cards / Taruhan); dialogue is Indonesian, so languages are corrected from the old meta's [en, id] to [id]; gambling is a card mini-game, not sexual content, so nsfw stays false; rating blank; popularity 2.

zh-Hans.summary: 印尼语大学生活模拟游戏：高中毕业生来到大城市求学，租下 kost（学生宿舍）、逛校园与商店街、在路边小吃摊吃饭，还能玩卡牌赌博小游戏。

en.summary: An Indonesian college-life simulation: a fresh high-school graduate moves to the big city to study, rents a kos (boarding room), explores the campus, shopping district and food stall, and plays a card-gambling mini-game.

ja.summary: インドネシア語の大学生活シミュレーション。高校を卒業した青年が進学のため大都会へ移り、コス（下宿）を借り、キャンパスや商店街、屋台を巡り、カード賭博のミニゲームも楽しめる。

college-st-bernard-de-drummondville.assessmentNote: No external trace; README: 'Jeux RPG pour le Collège St-Bernard fait par Vincent Bélanger et Henri-Victor Côté, basé sur RPG Maker MV'; game data 2 maps / 21 events / 24 French dialogue lines — a complete micro-game (arrival, name/age, grade placement, desk, maths quiz with right/wrong branches), not an empty shell; dialogue is French, so languages are corrected from the old meta's [en, fr] to [fr]; rating blank; popularity 2.

translatedTitles.zh-Hans: 德拉蒙德维尔圣伯纳德学院
translatedTitles.ja: コレージュ・サン＝ベルナール・ド・ドラモンヴィル

zh-Hans.summary: 两名学生为母校 Collège St-Bernard 制作的法语微型 RPG：新生入校，自我介绍年龄后按年级分班，老师带你到座位上，随后开始数学测验（6x7），答对答错各有分支。

en.summary: A French micro-RPG made by two students for their school, Collège St-Bernard de Drummondville: a new pupil arrives, gives their name and age, is placed in a grade, is shown to their desk, and takes a maths quiz (6x7) with right/wrong branches.

ja.summary: 生徒2人が母校コレージュ・サン＝ベルナールのために作ったフランス語のミニRPG。新入生が名前と年齢を答えて学年に振り分けられ、先生に席まで案内され、算数のクイズ（6×7）に挑む。正解・不正解で分岐する。

colours-missing-yikes.assessmentNote: No store page, reviews or media found (two web searches only return unrelated same-name works); game data 19 maps / 632 events / 740 dialogue lines across Magenta Land and multi-phase Greyscale Land with colour-tinting mechanics (Cyan/Magenta/Yellow switches); README claims a 'Best Technical and Story Excellence Award' but names no event, so it is noted here and not used as rating evidence; the old v1.1 rating 6 / popularity 3 have no external backing and are not carried over — rating blank, popularity 2.

translatedTitles.ja: カラーズ・ミッシング？！ヤイクス！

zh-Hans.summary: 2018 年学生解谜冒险游戏：故事发生在一台激光打印机内部，墨粉错误（TONER ERROR 0xC19A003）让世界只剩黑白，负责色彩的小机器人必须用上色能力找回品红、青、黄三色墨盒碎片，完成打印任务。

en.summary: A 2018 student puzzle-adventure set inside a laser printer: a toner error (TONER ERROR 0xC19A003) drains all colour but black and white, and the little robot in charge of toner must use colour-tinting powers to recover the missing Magenta, Cyan and Yellow cartridge pieces and finish the print job.

ja.summary: 2018年の学生パズルアドベンチャー。レーザープリンターの内部を舞台に、トナーエラー（TONER ERROR 0xC19A003）で白黒以外の色が消え去り、トナー担当の小さなロボットが着色能力でマゼンタ、シアン、イエローのカートリッジ片を取り戻し、印刷を完了させる。

conquesttttt.assessmentNote: No external trace; game data 2 maps / 19 events / 58 English dialogue lines — a complete exam-passing scene, not an empty shell; title note: the v1.1 meta title 'SEMESTER SURVIVAL' cannot be verified (System.json gameTitle empty, deployed index.html <title> empty, no 'Semester' in any map, title image is a default RTP asset), and the sibling repo broadwayyyy already migrated as semester-survival has entirely different content (0 shared dialogue lines, 12 maps vs 2), so this is a distinct game filed under its repo/list title conquesttttt; zh-Hans translated title left blank (the repo name is not meaningfully translatable); rating blank; popularity 2.

zh-Hans.summary: EC-Developer-Hub 的英文校园小品：走廊与教室两张地图，58 行对白全是同学们对“新生通过考试”的反应——有人喝彩、有人想合作开频道、对手则指控作弊。

en.summary: A small English campus vignette by EC-Developer-Hub: two maps (hallway and classroom) and 58 lines of classmates reacting to the new kid passing the exams — some cheer, one wants to collaborate on a video channel, and a rival accuses him of cheating.

ja.summary: EC-Developer-Hubによる英語の学園小品。廊下と教室の2マップで、新入生の試験合格に対するクラスメイトの反応58行——歓声を上げる者、動画チャンネルでのコラボを持ちかける者、カンニングを疑うライバル。

cordova-kuns-final-quest.assessmentNote: No store page or reviews (README and repos are the only sources); all three forks have identical game data (3 maps / 20 events / 29 English dialogue lines, same gameTitle, same Boss switch) — confirmed the same game; a complete mini-story arc with a boss, kept as contentType demo because it is Monaca's official sample game for demonstrating the framework (playable link https://monaca.github.io/rpg/ returns 200; masahirotanaka fork description points to a Monaca/Onsen UI SlideShare talk); dialogue is English (ja_JP is only the editor locale); rating blank; popularity 3 (official sample with a live playable link and talk references, above a 0-star student repo).

translatedTitles.ja: コルドバくんの最終クエスト

zh-Hans.summary: Monaca 官方示例游戏：21 世纪，小王国们（Symbiania、Palm 王国、MeeGo……）朝生暮死，开发者军队推举 Cordova-kun 为领袖，他习得 Onsen UI 法术、掌握 HTML5 与异步 JavaScript，于 2011 年出征讨伐恶棍、为开发者带来和平。

en.summary: Monaca's official sample game: in the 21st century, tiny kingdoms (Symbiania, Palm Kingdom, MeeGo...) rise and fall daily, and the developer army crowns Cordova-kun its leader; he masters HTML5, asynchronous JavaScript and Onsen UI spells and is sent in 2011 to defeat the villains and bring peace to developers.

ja.summary: Monaca公式のサンプルゲーム。21世紀、小さな王国（シンビアニア、パーム王国、MeeGo……）が日々興亡するなか、開発者軍はコルドバくんを盟主に推戴。彼はHTML5や非同期JavaScript、Onsen UIの呪文を習得し、2011年に悪役討伐へ赴き開発者に平和をもたらす。

zh-Hans.summary: 葡语竞速小游戏，双语多媒体制作课的期末项目：在学校里与 NPC 同学竞速，躲避障碍物，双方各有速度变量。

en.summary: A Portuguese race minigame, the final project of a bilingual multimedia production course: race an NPC classmate through the school, dodging obstacles, with speed variables for both racers.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のレースミニゲーム。バイリンガル・マルチメディア制作科目の期末制作で、学校を舞台にNPCのクラスメイトと競走し、障害物を避ける。両者に速度変数がある。

creative-journey.assessmentNote: No external trace (web search only finds the unrelated itch game 'Creator Journey'); game data 5 maps / 89 events / 279 Indonesian dialogue lines with typography/photography quiz switches and scoring variables, a boss switch (Boss_Kalah) and a time system; dialogue is Indonesian (English hits are loanwords like 'game' and one 'Have fun'), so languages are corrected from the old meta's [en, id] to [id]; rating blank; popularity 2.

zh-Hans.summary: 印尼语 DKV（视觉传达设计）校园冒险游戏：设计系学生 Arga 在排版公园、摄影屋与恶魔区之间探索，回答排版与摄影问答题，挑战 Boss，内置时间系统。

en.summary: An Indonesian DKV (visual communication design) school adventure: Arga, a design student, explores the typography park, the photography house and the demon area, answering typography and photography quiz questions, fighting a boss, with a time system running.

ja.summary: インドネシア語のDKV（ビジュアルコミュニケーションデザイン）学園アドベンチャー。デザイン科の学生アルガがタイポグラフィ公園、写真の家、悪魔エリアを巡り、タイポグラフィと写真のクイズに答え、ボスに挑む。時間システム付き。

crest-story.assessmentNote: No reviews or scores found anywhere (freem page states zero reviews; both GitHub repos 0 stars); only distribution is the freem.ne.jp listing (registered 2019-11-24, v2.51, content rating EVERYONE, ~4h, complete) plus szymor's English translation; both forks have identical game data (98 maps / 1565 events / 13171 dialogue lines); the 'adult' keyword hits in the English fork are ordinary dialogue ('You're an adult now — pay with your own money!'), not sexual content, so nsfw stays false; zh-Hans title 纹章物语 is a non-official translation; rating blank; popularity 2.

zh-Hans.summary: 一款王道、可爱又热血的角色扮演游戏，已完成，无需练级，通过 Boss 战与事件战斗推进剧情，通关约四小时，二周目还有追加要素与隐藏 Boss。

en.summary: A classic, cute and heartfelt RPG — a completed free game with no grinding, progressing through boss battles and event battles, focused on story; about four hours to clear, with extra content and a hidden boss on a second playthrough.

ja.summary: 王道でかわいくて熱いRPG。レベル上げ不要で、ボス戦とイベントバトルを繰り返して進む物語重視の完成済みフリーゲーム。クリア想定時間は4時間前後で、二周目以降の追加要素や裏ボスもある。

en.summary: A murder mystery puzzle game from DEJELY Bean Studio: investigate four murders, gather clues, solve puzzles and interrogate suspects, with three endings.

ja.summary: DEJELY Bean Studio による殺人ミステリーパズルゲーム。4件の殺人事件を調査し、手がかりを集め、パズルを解き、容疑者を尋問する。エンディングは3種類。

crimpo-quest.assessmentNote: Found on itch.io (superpizza, in development, ~1h session, 5.0/5 from only 3 ratings — too thin to score), Steam app 4192470 (Coming Soon to Early Access, free, ~1/4 of planned content but a complete start-to-finish arc), and a ModDB listing; no reviews or press beyond that; both forks are the same game (author repo + personal site; github.io fork is an earlier 54-map build vs the 84-map repo build); rating blank; popularity 3.

zh-Hans.summary: 暑假中的克林波被巫师 Spelefdo 开高尔夫球车撞倒、手机摔坏，只好设法让巫师修好手机。一款围绕开箱子、吃汉堡和收集物品展开的喜剧 RPG。

en.summary: Crimpo is on summer break when the wizard Spelefdo runs him over with a golf cart and breaks his phone — now he must get the wizard to fix it. A comedy RPG about opening boxes, eating hamburgers and collecting things on the way.

ja.summary: 夏休み中のクリンポは、魔法使いスペレフドにゴルフカートではねられ、携帯電話を壊されてしまう。電話を直してもらうため、箱を開けたりハンバーガーを食べたりしながら集めものを進めるコメディRPG。

cryptocasino.assessmentNote: GitHub 仓库以外零外部痕迹（网搜只命中无关真钱加密赌场 CryptoCasino.com / cryptocasino.run），0 stars；README 证实为 Symbol 测试网代币赌场小游戏合集（扑克、High & Low、二十一点 + XYM 兑换）；game data 2 maps / 56 events / 112 dialogue lines；nsfw false（エロ命中为ピエロ/小丑敌人名的子串误报）；ja 标题クリプトカジノ为非官方音译；rating blank; popularity 2.

en.summary: A Global Game Jam 2018 entry from the Nashville site (Vanderbilt Wond'ry, 36 hours, theme 'Transmission'): travel through worlds themed on game-development roles — programming, art, storytelling, sound design — with a boss room and a bonus level.

ja.summary: Global Game Jam 2018 ナッシュビル会場（ヴァンダービルト大学 Wond'ry、36時間、テーマ「Transmission」）の作品。プログラマー、アーティスト、ストーリーテラー、サウンドデザイナーといったゲーム開発の役割をテーマにした世界を巡り、ボス部屋とボーナスレベルに挑む。

dragon-warrior.assessmentNote: GitHub repo only (no Steam/itch/reviews); fan remake of NES Dragon Warrior (Dragon Quest I) in RPG Maker MV — Alefgard, Brecconary, Tantegel Castle, Erdrick's Sword, Dragonlord, 42 maps / 852 events / 523 dialogue lines; must not be confused with the official Dragon Quest or the itch project 'Dragon Warrior: Descendant of Erdrick' by another author; old 7/6 scores not carried (no evidence); translated titles are literal renderings, not the official DQ titles; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: NES《Dragon Warrior》（即《Dragon Quest I》）的 RPG Maker MV 同人重制：重现亚列弗加德大陆的完整流程——布雷科纳里、坦特吉尔城堡、艾尔德里克之剑与龙王决战。同人作品，与官方无关。

en.summary: An RPG Maker MV fan remake of the NES Dragon Warrior (Dragon Quest I): a full recreation of the Alefgard journey — Brecconary, Tantegel Castle, Erdrick's Sword, and the final battle with the Dragonlord. An unofficial fan work.

ja.summary: ファミコン版『Dragon Warrior』（『ドラゴンクエストI』）の RPG Maker MV による同人リメイク。アレフガルド大陸を巡る完全な旅——ブレコナリー、タンテゲル城、エルドリックの剣、竜王との決戦——を再現した非公式ファン作品。

dragons-den.assessmentNote: GitHub repos only; both forks have byte-identical game data (System.json versionId 78175902, 5 maps / 51 events / 24 dialogue lines); testgame (2026-05-30) is the earlier prototype build, Dragonsden (2026-06-01) the main repo — both listed as instances; Map001 has 6 real events (wallet display, blockchain sword claim, sword-gated guard, transfers); a small Web3 integration demo with a complete mini-loop; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 一款小型 Web3 RPG 演示：连接钱包（OKX/MetaMask），在链上领取区块链之剑 NFT，通过持剑守卫的检查，角色进度经 GraphQL 后端保存在以太坊 Sepolia 测试网。流程短小但完整。

en.summary: A small Web3 RPG demo: connect a wallet (OKX/MetaMask), claim a Blockchain Sword NFT on-chain, pass a sword-gated guard, and save progress through a GraphQL backend on Ethereum Sepolia. Short but complete.

ja.summary: 小型の Web3 RPG デモ。ウォレット（OKX/MetaMask）を接続し、ブロックチェーンソード NFT をオンチェーンで取得し、剣を持つ者のみ通す衛兵を越え、GraphQL バックエンド経由で Ethereum Sepolia に進行状況を保存する。短いながら一連の流れが完結している。

dreamcore-x1.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (1 star, no README, no Steam/itch/reviews; must not be confused with the Steam Unreal Engine game 'Dreamcore'); game data 5 maps / 24 events / 295 dialogue lines (Forest Town alone has 249 lines); dialogue is Indonesian; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 印尼作者 AdanRafli 的奇幻 RPG：英雄 Liyue 抵达森林小镇，遭遇自称野蛮人的怪人，冒险就此展开；武器店与防具店、抽卡与变身系统俱全。

en.summary: An Indonesian fantasy RPG by AdanRafli: the hero Liyue arrives in a forest town and crosses paths with a strange man who calls himself a Barbarian; weapon and armor shops, a gacha system, and transformations round out the small adventure.

ja.summary: インドネシアの作者 AdanRafli によるファンタジーRPG。英雄 Liyue が森の町に到着し、自らをバーバリアンと名乗る怪人と出会い、冒険が始まる。武器屋・防具屋、ガチャや変身システムを備える。

dreamtale.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars, no README, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 20 maps / 131 events / 603 dialogue lines with side quests (Ivanka, lost bear) and a day/night schedule system; dialogue is Russian; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 俄语奇幻 RPG：南方村庄正为丰收节做准备，主角卷入村庄的日常与支线——寻找失踪的熊、帮助邻里，日夜流转中推进剧情。

en.summary: A Russian fantasy RPG: the southern village prepares for the Harvest Festival while the hero gets drawn into village life and side quests — a lost bear, neighbours in need — as day turns to night.

ja.summary: ロシア語のファンタジーRPG。南の村が収穫祭の準備を進めるなか、主人公は村の日常とサイドクエスト——行方不明の熊、困っている隣人たち——に巻き込まれ、昼夜の移ろいのなかで物語が進む。

instances.notes: Full decompilation of DSaF 3 v2.0.4 (OpenDSAF3); game content is the original's.

dayshift-at-freddys-3.assessmentNote: Dedicated Fandom wiki + Game Jolt trilogy page + AO3 fanfic rewrite (2025-07-19) + 2025 article 'Is Dayshift at Freddy's worth watching?'; game data 200 maps / 1482 events / 18441 dialogue lines (tycoon days, Flipside missions, arcade RPG battles); the indexed entry is the OpenDSAF3 full decompilation of v2.0.4, not the original distribution; rating blank — no review score found (Game Jolt page sits behind a mature-audience interstitial; wiki documents but does not score); nsfw stays false — 'sex'/'adult'/'dick'/'fuck' hits are crude jokes or profanity located in the original dialogue, and Game Jolt's mature tag is for fantasy violence + alcohol reference; popularity 7.

translatedTitles.ja: デイシフト・アット・フレディーズ3

zh-Hans.summary: DirectDogman 的《玩具熊的五夜后宫》同人讽刺三部曲终章：2023 年，主角 Jack 买下 Freddy Fazbender 披萨店套装，经营自己的披萨店、打捞旧店的机械玩偶；夜里则进入灵魂栖息的“里侧”（Flipside），完成六个救赎任务，对抗 Henry Miller。另有街机对战玩法。

en.summary: The final chapter of DirectDogman's satirical Five Nights at Freddy's fan trilogy: in 2023, Jack buys a Start Your Own Freddy Fazbender's Pizza Kit and runs his own pizzeria — salvaging animatronics from abandoned locations by day — and enters the Flipside, where souls linger, to complete six redemption missions against Henry Miller. Arcade-machine RPG battles included.

ja.summary: DirectDogman による『Five Nights at Freddy's』の風刺同人三部作の最終章。2023年、主人公 Jack はフレディ・ファズベンダー・ピザ店キットを購入し、自分のピザ店を経営しながら廃墟となった旧店舗からアニマトロニクスを回収する。夜には魂が集う「裏側」（Flipside）に入り、6つの救済ミッションをこなして Henry Miller に立ち向かう。アーケードマシンでのRPGバトルも備える。

externalLinks.label: Game Jolt — Dayshift at Freddy's Trilogy

dual-escape.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars, no README, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 23 maps / 487 events / 900 dialogue lines — a complete two-player co-op puzzle chain (chest puzzle, prison keys, pie delivery, Annie's diary, master-room finale); dialogue is Cantonese in Traditional characters; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: デュアル・エスケープ

zh-Hans.summary: 粤语双人合作密室逃脱游戏：两名玩家在催眠师的引导下进入梦境，醒来发现身处一栋旧式大宅，须分头合作解开客房、地下室、游戏室与主人房的机关，找出大宅的秘密。

en.summary: A Cantonese two-player co-operative escape game: under a hypnotist's guidance, two players enter a dream and wake in an old mansion, where they must split up and cooperate through guest rooms, the basement, game rooms, and the master bedroom to uncover the mansion's secret.

ja.summary: 広東語の2人協力型脱出ゲーム。催眠術師の誘導で夢に入った2人のプレイヤーは古い大邸宅で目覚め、客室、地下室、ゲーム部屋、主人の部屋の仕掛けを分担して解き、邸宅の秘密を探る。

dungeons-crawler-something.assessmentNote: WebRPG mirror only (no sourceRepo, no sourceHeadSha, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 23 maps / 336 events / 857 dialogue lines — a complete dungeon crawl (five cave types, crystal restoration, Thieves' Guild + tower bosses, secret boss); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ダンジョンズ・クローラー・サムシング

zh-Hans.summary: 一款地牢探索 RPG：洞窟中的水晶相继失灵，冒险者公会派出小队深入石窟、下水道、冰窟、熔岩洞与诅咒洞窟，修复水晶，挑战盗贼公会与高塔之主，并有隐藏 Boss。

en.summary: A dungeon-crawling RPG: the crystals in the caves have failed, and the Adventurers' Guild sends a party deep into stone, sewer, ice, lava, and cursed caves to restore them, taking on the Thieves' Guild and the masters of the tower — with a secret boss waiting.

ja.summary: ダンジョン探索RPG。洞窟のクリスタルが次々と機能を失い、冒険者ギルドは一行を石窟、下水道、氷窟、溶岩洞、呪いの洞窟へ送り込む。クリスタルを修復し、盗賊ギルドと塔の主たちに挑む。隠しボスも待ち受ける。

eduventure.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars, no README, no Steam/itch/reviews; the Devpost 'Edu-venture' is a different 2017 Unity game); game data 8 maps / 160 events / 812 dialogue lines — subject-themed quiz stages with stage-progress switches; the 'dick' keyword hit is the quiz answer 'Moby-Dick', harmless; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 印尼教育 RPG：玩家在校园中穿梭于语言、艺术与技术等科目关卡，通过答题推进——莎士比亚、文学名著等课堂问答构成主要玩法。

en.summary: An Indonesian educational RPG: explore a school through subject-themed stages — language, arts, technology — answering classroom quiz questions (Shakespeare, classic literature, and more) to progress.

ja.summary: インドネシアの教育RPG。言語、芸術、技術などの科目別ステージが並ぶ校舎を巡り、シェイクスピアや古典文学などの授業クイズに答えて進む。

el-fili.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars, no README, no Steam/itch/reviews; web search returns only study material on Rizal's novel); game data 21 maps / 220 events / 693 dialogue lines adapting El Filibusterismo (steamboat arrival, churches, jails, forests, wedding venue); opening monologue is Tagalog; en title 'Reign of Greed' is the novel's English alternative title (also the old meta title field); zh-Hans title left blank (no verifiable Chinese title); rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 改编自菲律宾民族英雄黎刹 1891 年小说 El Filibusterismo 的 RPG：被认为已死的 Ibarra 以珠宝商 Simoun 的身份归来，誓要颠覆殖民统治；玩家乘蒸汽船抵达，在教堂、监狱与森林之间推进革命剧情。

en.summary: An RPG adapting José Rizal's 1891 novel El Filibusterismo: Ibarra, believed dead, returns as the jeweller Simoun, bent on overturning colonial rule; arrive by steamboat and push the revolutionary plot through churches, jails, and forests.

ja.summary: フィリピンの国民的英雄ホセ・リサールの1891年の小説『El Filibusterismo』を題材にしたRPG。死んだと思われていた Ibarra は宝石商 Simoun として帰国し、植民地支配の転覆を誓う。蒸気船で到着し、教会、牢獄、森を巡りながら革命の物語が進む。

el-redentor-mistico.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (README is two lines, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 21 maps / 830 events / 2321 dialogue lines — a complete RPG arc (shipwreck start, Clariate kingdom, Despaire ruins, castle tower, Hephaestus volcano, Dark Kingdom, Ending switch); dialogue is Spanish; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: エル・レデントール・ミスティコ

zh-Hans.summary: 西班牙语毕业设计（UOC）奇幻 RPG：主角遭遇海难后，在 Clariate 王国、Despaire 遗迹、Hefesto 火山与黑暗王国之间冒险，与 Fanny、Markius、Figur 等伙伴同行，对抗恶魔实体，迎接结局。

en.summary: A Spanish final-degree-project fantasy RPG (UOC): after a shipwreck, the hero adventures across the Kingdom of Clariate, the Ruins of Despaire, the Volcano of Hephaestus, and the Dark Kingdom, travelling with companions Fanny, Markius, and Figur to confront a demonic entity and reach the ending.

ja.summary: スペイン語の卒業制作（UOC）ファンタジーRPG。難破した主人公は Clariate 王国、Despaire 遺跡、Hefesto 火山、闇の王国を巡り、Fanny、Markius、Figur ら仲間とともに悪魔の存在に立ち向かい、結末へと進む。

eles-ainda-estao-nas-paredes.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (README is two lines, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 25 maps / 293 events / 792 dialogue lines — a complete haunted-mansion adventure (living room, basement maze, dream room, old-man/rats/face scenes, kitchen, office, library); dialogue is Portuguese (System.json locale is the RPG Maker default en_US); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 葡萄牙语恐怖冒险游戏：玩家走进一栋闹鬼的大宅，穿过客厅、地下室迷宫与走廊，经历梦境房间、老人、老鼠与面孔等场景，在厨房、办公室与图书馆之间追寻“墙里的东西”。

en.summary: A Portuguese horror adventure: step into a haunted mansion and cross the living room, the basement maze, and the corridors, living through the dream room, the old man, the rats, and the face scenes, and searching the kitchen, office, and library for what is still in the walls.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のホラーアドベンチャー。呪われた館に足を踏み入れ、居間、地下室の迷宮、廊下を進み、夢の部屋、老人、ネズミ、顔の場面を経て、台所、書斎、図書室で「壁の中にまだいるもの」を追う。

externalLinks.label: Play — Eles ainda estão nas paredes! (WebRPG)

elise.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no Steam/itch/reviews; must not be confused with the adult visual novel 'Elise and the Spellbinding Marionette', a different game); game data 13 maps / 75 events / 1823 dialogue lines — a dialogue-dense school drama VN (classrooms, music practice room, home; Dad, Anne, dinner confrontation, Shadow Figure); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语视觉小说：以学校为舞台的家庭剧情，1823 行对白贯穿教室、音乐练习室与家中场景——父亲、Anne、晚餐桌上的对峙，以及徘徊的黑影。

en.summary: An English visual novel: a school-set family drama told across 1,823 dialogue lines — classrooms, the music practice room, and home, with Dad, Anne, a dinner-table confrontation, and a lurking Shadow Figure.

ja.summary: 英語のビジュアルノベル。学校を舞台にした家族ドラマで、1,823行の台詞が教室、音楽練習室、家を貫く。父、Anne、夕食の対峙、そして忍び寄る影の人物。

embermon.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no README, no Steam/itch/reviews; must not be confused with blockchain monster games like Ethermon); game data 11 maps / 48 events / 91 dialogue lines — small but structurally complete (intro, town, house, Boston, Wasteland, Vault 111; starter selection, enemy battles, Pip-Boy-style menu); nsfw stays false — the 'sex' hit is the 'Sex/Male' character-sex selection switch; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 辐射风味的怪物收集 RPG：玩家在 Ember 小镇出发，穿过波士顿与废土，进入 111 号避难所；开局选择初始怪，沿途与敌人战斗，菜单致敬 Pip-Boy。

en.summary: A Fallout-flavoured monster-catching RPG: set out from Ember Town, cross Boston and the Wasteland, and enter Vault 111; pick a starter monster, battle enemies along the way, and navigate a Pip-Boy-style menu.

ja.summary: フォールアウト風のモンスター収集RPG。Ember の町から出発し、ボストンと荒野を越えて Vault 111 へ。最初のモンスターを選び、道中の敵と戦い、Pip-Boy 風メニューを使いこなす。

english-hero.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no README, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 17 maps / 119 events / 381 dialogue lines — a complete quiz-level loop (level init, vocabulary segments, review scoring, boss levels, campfire dialogue, fast travel); contentType demo — the repo is explicitly named EnglishHeroTrial; the original title already contains en + zh-Hant, so translatedTitles lists only zh-Hans (simplified form) and ja; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: イングリッシュ・ヒーロー

zh-Hans.summary: 繁中英语学习 RPG（试玩版）：玩家在胡迪村与 BM 森林之间冒险，通过关卡问答学生词——复习计分、Boss 关卡、营火对话，边打怪边背单词。

en.summary: A Traditional Chinese English-learning RPG (trial version): adventure through Hoodie Village and the BM Forest while learning English vocabulary through level quizzes — review scoring, boss levels, and campfire chats between battles.

ja.summary: 繁体字中国語の英語学習RPG（体験版）。フーディ村と BM の森を冒険しながら、レベルクイズで英単語を学ぶ。復習の採点、ボスレベル、焚き火の会話を交えて、戦いながら単語を覚える。

externalLinks.label: Play — English Hero 英語勇者 (WebRPG)

enigmaria.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no README, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 21 maps / 243 events / 204 dialogue lines — a complete puzzle chain (doors, buttons, stones m1–m15, clock activation, password door, ev1–ev15 switches) across Vila Fuya, houses, tower, prison, and labyrinth; translated titles are non-official (en is the accent-stripped title, zh-Hans is a transliteration); rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 葡萄牙语解谜冒险游戏：玩家来到 Vila Fuya 村，在 Diane、Mairla、Sarah 等人的屋子之间穿梭，解开门、按钮、石头、时钟与密码门构成的谜题链，深入高塔、监狱与迷宫。

en.summary: A Portuguese puzzle adventure: arrive in Vila Fuya and move between the houses of Diane, Mairla, Sarah, and the others, solving a puzzle chain of doors, buttons, stones, a clock, and a password door, down into the tower, the prison, and the labyrinth.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のパズルアドベンチャー。Vila Fuya 村に到着し、Diane、Mairla、Sarah らの家々を巡りながら、扉、ボタン、石、時計、暗証番号の扉からなる謎解きの連鎖を解き、塔、牢獄、迷宮へと進む。

escape-from-shangri-la.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no Steam/itch/reviews; must not be confused with Michael Morpurgo's 1998 children's novel or the Forgotten Futures tabletop adventure of the same name); README documents a complete game (3 levels, limited FOV mazes, 4 treasures per level, trap doors, timer); game data 9 maps / 15 events / 35 dialogue lines with a 22-line final sequence; themes left empty (no verifiable theme label); rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: シャングリラからの脱出

zh-Hans.summary: 儿童迷宫解谜游戏：每关都是一座视野受限的迷宫，收集 4 件宝藏、找到陷阱门进入下一关；每关前有一段小故事，计时器全程运转，终幕收束剧情。

en.summary: A children's maze puzzle game: each level is a maze with a small visible range around the character — collect 4 treasures, find the trap door to the next level, and race the timer, with a short story before each level and a final sequence to close it out.

ja.summary: 子ども向け迷路パズルゲーム。各レベルは視界の限られた迷宮で、4つの宝物を集め、罠の扉から次のレベルへ。タイマーが刻むなか、各レベルの前に短い物語があり、最終シークエンスで締めくくる。

eternal-mazes.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no Steam/itch/reviews; must not be confused with FredBear Games' mobile game 'Eternal Maze'); game data 71 maps / 941 events / 990 dialogue lines — a large RPG (four elemental labyrinths with start/final switches, three-floor demon castle, school intro, fishing village, party members Maria/Bryans/David, turn-based combat); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 西班牙语大型奇幻 RPG：玩家穿越火、冰、毒、雪四元素迷宫，攻入三层恶魔城堡，途经古代遗迹、学校与渔村，与 Maria、Bryans、David 等伙伴并肩作战。

en.summary: A large Spanish fantasy RPG: cross the four elemental labyrinths — fire, ice, poison, and snow — storm the three-floor demon castle, and pass through ancient ruins, a school, and a fishing village, fighting turn-based battles alongside Maria, Bryans, and David.

ja.summary: スペイン語の大作ファンタジーRPG。火・氷・毒・雪の4つの元素迷宮を越え、3階建ての魔王城に攻め込み、古代遺跡、学校、漁村を巡りながら、Maria、Bryans、David ら仲間とターン制バトルを繰り広げる。

etudes01.assessmentNote: WebRPG mirrors only (no README on one fork, Next.js boilerplate README on the other, no Steam/itch/reviews); both forks carry byte-identical game data (5 maps / 69 events / 152 dialogue lines, same map names, switches, and variables) — one game, two instances; developers left blank (both forks are personal-site hosts, author unconfirmed); translatedTitles are non-official (zh-Hans is a literal translation of Études, ja is katakana); rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 中文小品 RPG：主角接受委托，深入空中神殿、遗迹与沼泽之间探险；开场白、遗迹深处与沼泽小径构成一段短小完整的冒险。

en.summary: A Chinese bite-size RPG: accept a commission and explore between the sky temple, the ruins, and the swamp — a short, complete adventure from the opening lines to the ruins' depths.

ja.summary: 中国語の小品RPG。依頼を受け、空中神殿、遺跡、沼沢を巡る短くも完結した冒険。開幕の言葉から遺跡の奥へと物語が進む。

instances.title: Fairy Maze
instances.notes: English fan translation (SaveSub); expanded version, 108 maps

fairy-maze.assessmentNote: GitHub repos + webrpg mirrors only (no Steam/itch/wiki traces); three forks are one game (JA download and browser versions share identical 66-map lists and switch lists; the EN translation shares the same first 66 maps and adds 42 more, floors 6-7 + ending); game data 66-108 maps / 893-1371 events / 3484-5786 dialogue lines; nsfw corrected false->true (switches: くすぐり判定, 絶頂, おもらし, おっぱい, 触手, 拘束, 回想戦闘); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 2 (fan English translation + download/browser dual distribution = some spread, but no store or press traces).

zh-Hans.summary: 日式挠痒恋物迷宫 RPG：玩家深入妖精迷宫，在洞窟、洋館、砂漠、天空与梦之世界等多层迷宫中探索，遭遇挠痒、束缚与触手战斗，收集回想场景；英文翻译版为扩展版，新增 6–7 层与结局。

en.summary: A Japanese tickle-fetish maze RPG: delve into the fairy maze across multi-floor dungeons — caves, a mansion, a desert, the sky, and dream worlds — facing tickling, restraint, and tentacle battles and collecting recollection scenes; the English translation is an expanded version adding floors 6–7 and an ending.

ja.summary: 日本のくすぐりフェチ迷宮RPG。洞窟、洋館、砂漠、天空、夢の世界など多層の迷宮を探索し、くすぐり、拘束、触手バトルに挑み、回想シーンを集める。英語翻訳版は拡張版で、6～7階とエンディングを追加している。

externalLinks.label: Play — Fairy Maze ブラウザ版 (WebRPG)

fairy-maze-2.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no Steam/itch/wiki traces); game data 28 maps / 237 events / 330 dialogue lines — short but structurally complete (tutorial, LEVEL1 floors 5/10/15/20, mirror maze, boss battle, EX battle, recollection room, medal room); nsfw corrected false->true (switches: くすぐり攻撃, 失禁エンカウント, 触手, 回想部屋); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 《Fairy Maze》的续作：妖精迷宫第二章，玩家从レナ的家出发，经花园区域与镜面迷宫，逐层通过 LEVEL1 的 5/10/15/20 关，挑战 Boss 与 EX 战，在回想房间里重温战斗。

en.summary: The sequel to Fairy Maze: a second chapter in the fairy maze, setting out from Lena's house through the garden area and the mirror maze, climbing LEVEL1's floors 5/10/15/20 to a boss battle and an EX battle, with a recollection room to revisit fights.

ja.summary: 『Fairy Maze』の続編。レナの家から花園エリアと鏡の迷路を抜け、LEVEL1 の 5/10/15/20 階を登り、ボス戦と EX 戦に挑む妖精迷宮の第二章。回想部屋で戦いを振り返ることもできる。

fallen.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (README is one line 'CMPUT 250 Game'; no Steam/itch/reviews; must not be confused with the RPG Maker Forums game 'Fallen' about Cedrick the demon wolf, 2014, or Steam's 'Fallen ~Makina and the City of Ruins~'); game data 11 maps / 215 events / 1323 dialogue lines — a complete three-day structure (Day 1/2/3 + innkeeper switches, four minigames with cheat counters, find-the-cat and graffiti side content); cover is null (entry has none); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 阿尔伯塔大学 CMPUT 250 课程作品：三日小镇冒险，玩家在 Havoton 小镇度过三天——与旅店老板、占卜师和镇民交谈，玩绘画、天空、墙与卡牌小游戏，帮人找猫，在涂鸦与流言之间推进剧情。

en.summary: A University of Alberta CMPUT 250 course game: a three-day town adventure in Havoton — talk to the innkeeper, the fortune teller, and the townsfolk, play drawing, sky, wall, and card minigames, find a lost cat, and follow graffiti and gossip across three days.

ja.summary: アルバータ大学 CMPUT 250 の授業作品。Havoton の町で過ごす三日間の冒険。宿屋の主人、占い師、町民と話し、絵画、空、壁、カードのミニゲームで遊び、迷子の猫を探しながら、落書きと噂のなかで物語を進める。

fd.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no README, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 21 maps / 292 events / 171 dialogue lines — town, mansion, Chinese-style city, temple, office building and lab, plus a three-floor trap dungeon (95 trap events on 1f, 62 on 3f) with a boss; dialogue verified English in the indexed build (a Chinese-version toggle exists in the switches but the indexed build speaks English); title is alphanumeric so translatedTitles is blank (B-35 precedent); themes left empty (no verifiable theme label); rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 地牢探索 RPG：玩家扮演探险者，穿梭于小镇、宅邸、中国风城市、寺庙与办公楼之间，收集神器碎片；深入三层陷阱地牢，躲开重重机关，击败守卫、挑战 Boss，夺回碎片。

en.summary: A dungeon-crawling RPG: play an explorer moving between a town, a mansion, a Chinese-style city, a temple, and an office building while hunting artifact fragments; descend a three-floor trap dungeon, dodge its mechanisms, defeat the guards, and challenge the boss to reclaim the fragments.

ja.summary: ダンジョン探索RPG。探検家となり、町、邸宅、中国風の都市、寺院、オフィスビルを巡りながらアーティファクトの欠片を集める。三層の罠ダンジョンに挑み、仕掛けをかわして守衛を倒し、ボスに挑んで欠片を取り戻す。

fear-and-hunger.assessmentNote: Steam 23,064 reviews, 94% positive (Very Positive), Steambase Player Score 94/100 (9.2/10); Wikipedia: generally positive reviews (atmosphere, gameplay, storytelling, difficulty praised; typos, bugs, and handling of sexual violence / drugs / violence towards children criticized); RPGFan review 2026-10-31 ('perhaps the best survival horror RPG to date'); Rock Paper Shotgun ('a brutal horror dungeon crawl'); sequel Termina 15,700 reviews, 97% positive; Fandom wiki; GameFAQs 4.09/5 (50 users); all three forks are the same build (System.json versionId 14145329); game data 169 maps / 27,715 events / ~90k dialogue lines; rating 9 (not 10: typos, bugs, and mature-theme handling); popularity 9 (23k Steam reviews + sequel + dedicated wiki + mainstream press, still niche horror, not breakout 10).

translatedTitles.ja: フィアー・アンド・ハンガー

zh-Hans.summary: 2018 年生存恐怖地牢 RPG：四名主角（佣兵 Cahara、骑士 D'arce、黑暗祭司 Enki、流浪者 Ragnvaldr）之一深入恐惧与饥饿的地牢，寻找佣兵首领 Le'garde；部位破坏回合制战斗、饥饿与理智系统、掷币存档、多结局，氛围压抑、难度残酷。

en.summary: A 2018 survival horror dungeon crawler: play one of four protagonists — the mercenary Cahara, the knight D'arce, the dark priest Enki, or the outlander Ragnvaldr — and delve into the Dungeons of Fear and Hunger to find the mercenary leader Le'garde; limb-targeting turn-based combat, hunger and sanity systems, coin-toss saves, and multiple endings in a relentlessly oppressive dungeon.

ja.summary: 2018年のサバイバルホラー・ダンジョンクローラー。傭兵 Cahara、騎士 D'arce、闇の司祭 Enki、流れ者 Ragnvaldr の4人から1人を選び、恐怖と飢餓のダンジョンに潜り傭兵団長 Le'garde を探す。部位破壊のターン制バトル、飢餓と正気度、コイントスのセーブ、マルチエンディング。容赦ない難易度と重苦しい雰囲気が特徴。

fire-and-root.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (README is one line, no Steam/itch/reviews; must not be confused with Steam's 'Project Fire'); game data 4 maps / 107 events / 216 dialogue lines — four scenes (Escena 1-4), a dog-delivery quest (Perro Entregado) and a final battle (Batalla Final); themes left empty (no verifiable theme label); translated titles are non-official (original title is already English words); rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 西班牙语短篇 RPG：四个场景构成的完整小故事——接下送狗的委托，带着篮子穿行于场景之间，最终迎来一场战斗；短小而结构完整。

en.summary: A Spanish short story RPG told in four scenes: take on a quest to deliver a dog, carry the basket between scenes, and face a final battle — a small, complete story.

ja.summary: スペイン語の短編RPG。4つのシーンで綴る完結した小話。犬を届ける依頼を受け、籠を手にシーンを巡り、最後の戦いに挑む。短くも構造は完璧。

for-the-world.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (README is one line, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 33 maps / 104 events / 185 dialogue lines — a complete arc (opening cutscene in 8 parts, tutorial, Headmaster Academy, Sky Island, castle library/hall, final battle with Evil Transformation, Ending Closure parts 1-3, Resolution; switches felixDefeatsAsmodeus, hallMonster#1/#2Gone); dialogue is thin (185 lines) but the structure is complete; cover is null (entry has none); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语剧情 RPG：开场过场讲述王国、姐妹、法杖与野兽的故事，随后是学院教学、天空岛与城堡探索，最终迎来邪恶变身的终战，再以三段结局收束与和解收尾；对白虽薄，但开场→教学→学院→终战→结局的弧线完整。

en.summary: An English story RPG: an opening cutscene of kingdoms, sisters, a staff, and beasts, then academy tutorials, a sky island and castle exploration, a final battle against an evil transformation, and a three-part ending closure with a resolution — thin on dialogue, but the full arc from opening to ending is there.

ja.summary: 英語のストーリーRPG。王国、姉妹、杖、野獣のオープニングから、学園のチュートリアル、天空島と城の探索、邪悪な変身との最終決戦へ。三部構成のエンディングと結末で締めくくる。台詞は薄いが、開幕から結末までの流れは完結している。

forgotten-weekend.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (README is one line, no Steam/itch/reviews; must not be confused with Steam's 'Forgotten Beginnings'); game data 7 maps / 58 events / 86 dialogue lines — a complete morning routine (Bed map: 54 lines; ClothOn, FoodEaten, Take_Bath, Alaram_Stop, Phone_OFF switches) ending on the train (Train_Inside: 27 events); the 'fuck' hits are frustration exclamations while dressing / in the hallway, not sexual content, so nsfw stays false; repo name contains DEV but the content reads as a complete short vignette, so contentType is full-game; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语晨间小品：一个被遗忘的周末早晨——起床、穿衣、吃饭、洗澡、关掉闹钟与电话，乘电梯下楼，登上火车；短小完整的日常片段，火车车厢里的猫、狗与狼是沿途的点缀。

en.summary: An English morning vignette: a forgotten weekend morning — wake up, get dressed, eat, take a bath, silence the alarm and the phone, ride the lift down, and board the train; a short, complete slice of life, with a dog, a wolf, and a cat along for the ride.

ja.summary: 英語の朝の小品。忘れられた週末の朝。起きて、着替えて、食べて、風呂に入り、アラームと電話を止め、エレベーターで降りて電車に乗る。短くも完結した日常の断片。犬、狼、猫が道連れ。

fouzis-quest-2.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars; web search finds no Steam/itch/wiki/press traces, only unrelated games named Fuzzy/Foggy/Queen's Quest 2); game data 63 maps / 676 events / 1121 dialogue lines — a complete quest chain (prison escape, Paris, Rome/Vatican boss, Madrid) with named quest variables; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 法式喜剧 RPG：主角越狱后一路从巴黎打到罗马与梵蒂冈、再到马德里，63 张地图、任务链（越狱、巴黎袭击、梵蒂冈王座）与 1121 行法语对白，结构完整的长篇业余作品。

en.summary: A French comedy RPG: after a prison escape, the quest runs from Paris to Rome and the Vatican, then Madrid — 63 maps, a quest chain (prison retreat, the attack on Paris, the Vatican throne), and 1,121 lines of French dialogue in a full-length amateur game.

ja.summary: フランスのコメディRPG。脱獄から始まり、パリ、ローマとバチカン、マドリードへと続く旅。63マップ、クエストの連鎖（脱獄、パリ襲撃、バチカンの玉座）、1121行のフランス語の台詞を備えた長編のアマチュア作品。

instances.title: Frayed System
instances.notes: Executable deployment build; 18 maps vs 20 in the web build

frayed-system.assessmentNote: GitHub repos + webrpg mirrors only (both repos 0 stars; web search finds no Steam/itch/wiki/press traces, only unrelated 'Fray'/'FRAYED' games); two forks are one game (same title/owner/map structure: floors 1-5, server room, CEO office; the Exe repo is explicitly the deployment executable of the same game; different versionId = different builds); game data 20/18 maps, 850/657 events, 478/284 dialogue lines; genres changed from old [rpg] to [adventure] + mechanics stealth/hacking (no battles/levels/stats, no RPG basis — MQ-075 precedent); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 潜行恐怖冒险：深入一栋五层大楼，躲避视觉与声音两种 AI 的追捕，用黑客装置瘫痪监控、刷门禁卡开门、靠检查点推进，从一层爬到服务器机房与 CEO 办公室。

en.summary: A stealth horror adventure: infiltrate a five-floor building, evade two kinds of hunting AI — Vision and Sound — hack cameras and lights, swipe keycards through locked doors, and push from checkpoint to checkpoint up to the server room and the CEO's office.

ja.summary: ステルスホラー・アドベンチャー。5階建てのビルに潜入し、視覚と聴覚の2種類のAIの追跡をかわしながら、ハッキング装置で監視を無力化し、キーカードで扉を開け、チェックポイントを頼りにサーバールームとCEOオフィスを目指す。

fubuki-h-game.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars; web search finds no traces of this game, only unrelated Fubuki fan games); game data 2 maps / 7 events / 42 dialogue lines — small but a complete loop (intro story, bed interactions, H-spirit values, days-together counter, climax-count livestream unlocks, sleep/save), not an empty shell; author 山含 per the in-game note; protagonist is Hololive VTuber Shirakami Fubuki (fan work); nsfw true confirmed by explicit sex-act variables (做愛次數, 口交次數, 前穴/肛門插入, 失神氣絕, 直播次數); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 白上吹雪同人 H 小游戏：新经纪人“蜀叔”上门，催眠与 H 直播的计划就此展开；每天到床上与吹雪互动，积累 H 精神值与各玩法的高潮次数，解锁直播画面，睡一觉恢复精神、推进天数。作者自述为第一次接触游戏制作的练习作品。

en.summary: A fan-made H mini-game starring Hololive VTuber Shirakami Fubuki: her new manager 'Uncle Shu' arrives, and a hypnosis and H-livestream scheme unfolds; each day, interact with Fubuki in bed, build H-spirit values and climax counts across acts to unlock livestream scenes, then sleep to recover and advance the day counter. The author's own note calls it a first practice project.

ja.summary: ホロライブVTuber白上フブキの同人Hミニゲーム。新マネージャー「蜀叔」の訪問をきっかけに、催眠とH配信の計画が動き出す。毎日ベッドでフブキと触れ合い、H精神値と各プレイの絶頂回数を積み上げて配信シーンを解放し、眠って回復と日数進行。作者自身が「初めてのゲーム制作の練習作品」と記している。

luti.assessmentNote: Personal-site repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars; web searches for 露蒂亚王国 / 盗贼篇 欧克篇 露蒂 find no external traces); game data 20 maps / 104 events / 1524 dialogue lines — thief route + orc route + demon castle + pregnancy ending + recollection room, a complete adult RPG, not an empty shell; nsfw corrected false->true (routes: 盗賊初エッチ/縄H, オーク輪姦, 妊娠; switches レイプ/青姦レイプ; map hit フェラ); languages corrected [zh-Hans]->[zh-Hant] (dialogue is Traditional Chinese); the game has no verifiable title (gameTitle 'Game', stock title image, index.html title 'Game'), so it is keyed by its heroine 露蒂; structurally resembles 堕ち姫ルーシア物語 but heroine name, kingdom name, manipulator name and starting level (1 vs 99) all differ, so identity is NOT confirmed; original author unknown (a re-upload on a personal site; plugins.js is jsjiami-obfuscated); rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 成人奇幻 RPG：金发萝莉公主露蒂落入盗贼与欧克之手，在城镇、盗贼据点与魔王城之间经历多条 H 路线——盗贼篇、欧克篇、魔王城结局与怀孕结局，并设回想房间重温场景。对白为繁体中文，地图名为日文原名。

en.summary: An adult fantasy RPG: the blonde loli princess Luti falls into the hands of thieves and orcs, playing through multiple H routes across the town, the thieves' hideout, and the demon castle — a thief route, an orc route, a demon-castle ending, and a pregnancy ending — with a recollection room to revisit the scenes. Dialogue is in Traditional Chinese; map names are in Japanese.

ja.summary: 成人ファンタジーRPG。金髪の幼い王女ルティが盗賊とオークの手に落ち、町、盗賊のアジト、魔王城を舞台に複数のHルートを辿る。盗賊編、オーク編、魔王城エンディング、妊娠エンディング、そして回想部屋でシーンを振り返る。台詞は繁体字中国語、地図名は日本語のまま。

rpg-game1.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (no README, no Steam/itch/reviews; GitHub API rate-limited when checking stars, does not change the conclusion: no external traces); game data 9 maps / 79 events / 40 dialogue lines — a real loop (NPC gifts, a recruitment battle with win/lose branches, a treasure chest, 35 transfers across town/castle/inn/shop), not an empty shell; title is alphanumeric so translatedTitles is blank (B-35/FD precedent); rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 中文小品 RPG：城镇、城堡、大房子与旅馆构成的 9 张地图；村民送上金币、药水与衣服，高台木屋旁的英雄以一场战斗考验主角，胜则入队，城堡宝箱里还有 200 金币。短小但玩法完整。

en.summary: A small Chinese RPG across 9 maps — a town, a castle, a big house, an inn, and a weapon shop: a villager hands over gold, potions, and clothes, a hero by the wooden house tests you in battle and joins the party if you win, and a castle chest holds 200 gold. Short, but mechanically complete.

ja.summary: 中国語の小品RPG。町、城、大きな家、宿屋、武器屋の9マップ。村人が金貨、薬、服をくれ、木の家のそばの英雄がバトルで試し、勝てば仲間になる。城の宝箱には200ゴールド。短いが仕組みは完結している。

gamedev-the-beginning.assessmentNote: itch.io page (Released, HTML5/Windows/Linux, JRPG, IGMC 2017, devlog to 2024-08-22) + GitHub repo (1 star) + webrpg mirror; no ratings/reviews found, so rating is blank; game data 8 maps / 153 events / 431 dialogue lines — a complete jam arc (Joe's room, sewers, forest, slime/mushroom battles, forest boss, Vito joins); old meta had no languages field, dialogue verified English; translated titles are non-official; popularity 2 (itch page + jam entry + GitHub = some spread, but no reviews or press).

zh-Hans.summary: IGMC 2017 参赛作品：想当游戏开发者的 Joe 从自家房间出发，穿过下水道与森林，与史莱姆和蘑菇战斗，迎战森林 Boss，结识同伴 Vito——一场关于做游戏的游戏。

en.summary: An IGMC 2017 jam game: Joe, who wants to become a game developer, sets out from his room, fights slimes and mushrooms through the sewers and the forest, faces a forest boss, and recruits Vito — a game about making games.

ja.summary: IGMC 2017参加作品。ゲーム開発者になりたいJoeが自室を出発し、下水道と森を抜けてスライムやキノコと戦い、森のボスに挑み、仲間Vitoと出会う。ゲーム作りについてのゲーム。

get-2-school.assessmentNote: GitHub repo (personal site, game under personalProjects/Get 2 School/) + webrpg mirror only (no README, no Steam/itch/reviews; GitHub API rate-limited when checking stars, does not change the conclusion: no external traces); game data 7 maps / 54 events / 99 dialogue lines — a complete small loop (home, boulder pass, two dungeons, forest pass, day/night + days system, torch switches, a dragon boss variable, fishing RNG); the debugroom map is a dev leftover, not a demo marker; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ゲット・トゥ・スクール

zh-Hans.summary: 上学路上的小冒险：从家里出发，穿过巨石通道与森林小径，深入两座地牢，点亮火把、按昼夜与天数推进，在龙 Boss 面前证明自己，只为按时到校。

en.summary: A small adventure on the way to school: set out from home, cross the boulder pass and the forest trail, delve into two dungeons, light torches, and advance through a day/night and days system to face a dragon boss — all to get to school on time.

ja.summary: 学校へ行く途中の小さな冒険。家を出て、岩の峠と森の小道を越え、2つのダンジョンに潜り、松明を灯し、昼夜と日数のシステムで進み、ドラゴンのボスに挑む。すべては学校に間に合うために。

get-schooled.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars, no cover; web search for 'Get Schooled' finds only a card game and a Korean webtoon, both different works); game data 3 maps / 214 events / 301 dialogue lines, repo description 'A game inspired by Baldi's.'; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 受《Baldi's Basics》启发的校园恐怖小品：主角 Min 在迷宫、学校与民居三张地图间穿行，躲避杀手与史莱姆，走两条路线，301 行粗口喜剧对白。

zh-Hans.summary: 俄语奇幻 RPG：选择职业、起名字，在教官指导下学习战斗——收集蝙蝠翅膀、讨伐史莱姆，接受法师之屋任务；穿过森林城市、山村、渔村与法师公会，深入恶魔城堡三层；另有昼夜时间系统与作物掉落。30 张地图、411 个事件、94 行对白；游戏内标题仅为 Project1，slug 取自仓库名。

en.summary: A Russian fantasy RPG: pick a class, name your hero, and learn to fight under an instructor — gather bat wings, hunt slimes, take the mage-house quest; travel through the forest city, mountain village, fishing village and mages' guild, and delve three floors of the demon castle; a day/night time system and crop drops round it out. 30 maps, 411 events, 94 dialogue lines; the in-game title is only 'Project1', so the slug comes from the repository name.

ja.summary: ロシア語のファンタジーRPG。クラスを選び、名前を付けて、教官の指導で戦い方を学ぶ——コウモリの翼を集め、スライムを討伐し、魔法使いの家のクエストを受ける。森の都市、山村、漁村、魔法使いギルドを巡り、悪魔の城の三層に挑む。昼夜システムと作物ドロップもある。30マップ・411イベント・94行の台詞。ゲーム内タイトルは「Project1」のみのため、スラッグはリポジトリ名から取る。

ja.summary: 繁体字中国語の『ソードアート・オンライン』ファンRPG。主人公は天に届く巨木を登って天空の城に辿り着き、茅場晶彦の開幕演説とナーヴギアの完全潜行設定を再現する。はじまりの街、呪われた洞窟、浮遊都市、氷窟、悪魔城3階を冒険する。10マップ・73行の台詞。ゲーム内タイトルは「Project2」のみのため、スラッグはリポジトリ名から取る。

ja.summary: 中国語の学園生活コメディRPG。部長が部員たちを集めて火鍋とプレゼント探しに奔走する——潜入作戦、野良猫、お年玉、「戦術的迂回」と称する迷子。小梅、小雪、小蘭が次々と仲間になる。15マップ・514行の台詞。ゲーム内タイトルは「Project3」のみのため、スラッグはリポジトリ名から取る。

en.summary: An Indonesian historical drama RPG starring the national hero Prince Diponegoro: the Dutch build a road through the ancestral graves of Tegalrejo village, and the Prince rides out to verify the report, recruits at least three companions, races a medicine timer, and marches toward war and the ending. 18 maps, 163 dialogue lines; the title was verified on the title screen.

ja.summary: インドネシア語の歴史ドラマRPG。国民的英雄ディポネゴロ王子が主人公——オランダ人が祖先の墓地を通る道路を建設し、王子は村へ赴いて真相を確かめ、少なくとも3人の仲間を集め、薬のタイマーと戦い、戦争と結末へ向かう。18マップ・163行の台詞。タイトルはタイトル画面で確認済み。

en.summary: A Spanish literary adventure: on the last day of the school year, Federico walks out of school into the streets of Palermo and the port — an interior monologue about words, memory and farewells runs through it. 6 maps, 114 dialogue lines; no battles, driven by exploration and dialogue.

ja.summary: スペイン語の文学アドベンチャー。学年最後の日、フェデリコは学校を出てパレルモの街と港へ——言葉、記憶、別れについての内省的なモノローグが全編を貫く。6マップ・114行の台詞。戦闘はなく、探索と会話で進む。

en.summary: A Spanish job-interview simulation mini-game embedded in QhatuLab, a labor-inclusion platform by the SeedMinds team: walk through two offices answering interview questions — 'Tell me about yourself', 'What accommodations do you need?' 4 maps, 55 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: スペイン語の就職面接シミュレーション・ミニゲーム。SeedMindsチームの労働インクルージョン・プラットフォーム QhatuLab に組み込まれたもの。二つのオフィスを巡り、「自己紹介をしてください」「どんな配慮が必要ですか」といった面接の質問に答える。4マップ・55行の台詞。

ja.summary: 英語の異世界アドベンチャー。大学生アンセルムはインターン初日の朝に寝坊し、祖父母に見送られてヨーク・ニュー・シティを越え、研究所へ向かう。家に帰る道を探す旅の始まり。9マップ・112行の台詞。都市移動システムと昼夜切替つき。

en.summary: An English school RPG demo: Tom is trapped in his former high school, now corrupted under Mr. Quill's evil powers, recruiting eight party members, learning moves and trinkets, and fighting through the Quadrangle and its corridors. The author labels it a demo with only the Quadrangle somewhat done, but character select, a shop, a warm-up battle and phone-a-friend already form a complete demo loop.

ja.summary: 英語の学園RPGデモ。トムはクイル先生の邪悪な力に蝕まれた母校に囚われ、8人の仲間を集め、技とトリンケットを学びながらクアドラングルと廊下を探索して戦う。作者自身がデモと明記し、ほぼ完成しているのはクアドラングルのみだが、キャラ選択・ショップ・ウォームアップ戦・電話での助っ人呼び出しで一通りの試遊ループが成立している。

raison-d-etre.assessmentNote: No external traces found for this build; 4 maps / 67 events / 341 English dialogue lines in-repo (outside + house + theatre troupe 'ED' in the Rabbit's Room, 221 lines + a masked figure 'You possess a truly tragic soul'; radish errand variable; 61 choices, 0 battles so genres [adventure]); README 'Project RDE' (director nagatoro) plot: post-war church slaughtering dissenters, a hero born but feared. zh-Hans.summary: 英语冒险游戏：战后世界里，教会以信仰之名屠杀异己，而每隔一段时间便有一位英雄诞生——却从不受珍视。玩家走进小屋与剧团“ED”的兔子房间，遇见戴面具的人物与萝卜跑腿任务。4 张地图、341 行对白、61 个选择。

The player visits a house and the theatre troupe 'ED' in the Rabbit's Room, meeting a masked figure and running a radish errand. 4 maps, 341 dialogue lines, 61 choices.

ja.summary: 英語のアドベンチャー。戦後の世界で教会は信仰の名のもとに異端者を虐殺し、時折英雄が生まれるが——決して慈しまれず、ただ恐れられる。プレイヤーは家と劇団「ED」のウサギの部屋を訪れ、仮面の人物に出会い、大根のお使いをこなす。4マップ・341行の台詞・61の選択肢。

en.summary: An English fairy-tale RPG: from Little Red Riding Hood's house through the deep jungle to the castle, then into a white-versus-black chess kingdom — soldier, chariot, knight, queen, king and bishop maps for both colours; Alice waits in the dungeon, and Sofia and Peter say goodbye in the final chapter. 45 maps, 8,679 dialogue lines, 97 battles; class-change, crafting and spirit-counter systems.

ja.summary: 英語の童話RPG。赤ずきんの家からジャングルの奥を抜けて城へ、さらに白と黒が対峙するチェスの王国へ——兵士・戦車・騎士・女王・王・司教が両色それぞれ一枚のマップに。地下牢にはアリス、終章ではソフィアとピーターが別れを告げる。45マップ・8679行の台詞・97戦闘。転職・製作・精霊カウンターのシステムつき。

ja.summary: 日本語の『UNDERTALE』ファンRPG。洋館のテーマ別ルームが次々と開く——ジャッジメントホール、カボチャの部屋、ピアノの部屋、雪の回廊、こたつ部屋、お菓子の国、悪夢1〜4、エンディング集、「優しい世界」。サンズのACTコマンド、フリスクカウンター、ハガレンごっこの場面も。61マップ・7448行の台詞。
