MQ-274, where the placeholder was the substance); GitHub API rate-limited, stars unverified; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: レリキアス・デ・フェン

zh-Hans.summary: 葡萄牙语奇幻 RPG：从村庄出发，取剑、盾、头盔与铠甲，穿过岛屿与地牢击败 Boss，再深入冰之城堡与冰之地牢挑战第二个 Boss。11 张地图、45 场战斗；世界地图上有一行“<colocar msg>”占位文本，但只是单行占位，不影响整体。

en.summary: A Portuguese fantasy RPG: set out from the village, take up sword, shield, helm and armor, cross the island and the dungeon to beat the boss, then delve into the ice castle and the ice dungeon for a second boss. 11 maps, 45 battles; one '<colocar msg>' placeholder line sits on the world map, but it is a single placeholder, not the game's substance.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のファンタジーRPG。村を出て剣・盾・兜・鎧を手にし、島とダンジョンを越えてボスを倒し、さらに氷の城と氷のダンジョンで二体目のボスに挑む。11マップ・45戦闘。ワールドマップに「<colocar msg>」というプレースホルダー行が1行あるが、単発のものでゲーム全体の内容ではない。

renewal.assessmentNote: No external traces found (all Excalibur search results are unrelated works); 37 maps / 628 events / 440 English dialogue lines in-repo (young knight of Gratia quests outside forbidden borders for Marisacordia's harvest per README summary; gear quests — steal medicine/wares, kidnap — Mount Thulu, Altar of Truth, three endings incl. 'Sac Other' and 'Destroy Altar'; 5 battles, 7 choices); gameTitle 'Renewal' is originalTitle, README/repo name 'Excalibur' recorded as aliases.en (cf. MQ-040 BilioGame, MQ-194 leyenda); GitHub API rate-limited, stars unverified; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语奇幻 RPG：Gratia 的年轻骑士为家乡 Marisacordia 的丰收踏出禁令之外的边境，取得武器与神器，在风笛城、图卢山与真理祭坛之间完成偷药、偷货与绑架等任务，走向三个结局。37 张地图、440 行对白。

en.summary: An English fantasy RPG: a young knight of Gratia quests beyond his town's forbidden borders to secure another successful harvest season for Marisacordia, taking up weapons and artifacts and completing gear quests — stealing medicine and wares, a kidnapping — across Windpipe City, Mount Thulu and the Altar of Truth, toward three endings. 37 maps, 440 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語のファンタジーRPG。グラティアの若き騎士は故郷マリサコルディアの豊作のため、禁じられた国境の外へ旅立つ。武器と神器を手に、風笛の街、トゥル山、真実の祭壇を巡り、薬や物資の窃取、誘拐といったクエストをこなして三つの結末へ向かう。37マップ・440行の台詞。

rescue-mission.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Sega's 'Rescue Mission' and Cal Jepso's itch game are unrelated); 7 maps / 47 events / 86 dialogue lines in-repo (44 Spanish / 41 English by full-map script count — bilingual, language corrected from old [es] to [es, en]); Act structure (Acto 1: El Inicio, Acto 2: El Explorador Perdido): Pipe wakes with no memory, finds a bow, gathers Conne/Tensuri/Alpa, rescues Tibumist from a dungeon cell ('Lobo muerto' / 'Tibu Rescatada' switches), rescues Chayanne, final battle; 4 battles, 0 shops; meme-heavy dialogue (Kame hame wave, Charizard, Zelda jokes); repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: レスキュー・ミッション

zh-Hans.summary: 西英双语喜剧 RPG：Pipe 一觉醒来失去了记忆，在森林里捡到一把弓，集结 Conne、Tensuri 与 Alpa 等伙伴，深入地牢救出 Tibumist，再去营救 Chayanne，最后迎来决战。7 张地图、86 行对白；对白混杂西班牙语与英语梗（龟派气功、喷火龙、塞尔达玩笑）。

en.summary: A bilingual Spanish/English comedy RPG: Pipe wakes up with no memory, finds a bow in the forest, gathers a party (Conne, Tensuri, Alpa), breaks Tibumist out of a dungeon cell, then rescues Chayanne, and fights a final battle. 7 maps, 86 dialogue lines; the dialogue mixes Spanish and English memes (Kamehameha, Charizard, Zelda jokes, Chayanne).

ja.summary: スペイン語と英語のバイリンガル・コメディRPG。記憶を失って目覚めたパイプは森で弓を拾い、コンネ、テンスリ、アルパら仲間を集めて地下牢からティブミストを救い出し、さらにチャヤンネを救出して最終決戦へ。7マップ・86行の台詞。台詞はスペイン語と英語のネタが混ざる（かめはめ波、リザードン、ゼルダのジョーク、チャヤンネ）。

return-to-sender.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Red Loom's itch 'Return To Sender' is a post-office stamping game, Control's AWE mission is unrelated); 9 maps / 81 events / 111 dialogue lines in-repo (107 English / 4 Chinese by full-map script count — language corrected from old [en] to [en, zh-Hans]; the Chinese lines are full dialogue from NPC 林躍, e.g. '这里太冷了 我讨厌英国!'); Jenny must return a box to the post office before it closes, the box moves on its own ('How did the box get over here on its own...?'), trail ends in a 'Hell' map; 2 battles, 3 shops, 10 choices; Tolworth / Kingston University are real London locations; repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: リターン・トゥ・センダー

zh-Hans.summary: 英语轻喜剧取物冒险：Jenny 忘了退掉一个包裹，必须在邮局关门前赶到；可包裹总会自己跑到别处，邮局职员对她的退货早已见怪不怪，一路追踪最后竟通向“地狱”。9 张地图、111 行对白；托尔沃斯与金斯顿大学是真实的伦敦地名，另有中国留学生林躍的中文对白。

en.summary: An English light-hearted fetch adventure: Jenny forgot to return a box and must reach the post office before it closes — but the box keeps moving on its own, the post office assistant is used to her returns, and the trail ends in a 'Hell' map. 9 maps, 111 dialogue lines; Tolworth and Kingston University are real London locations, and Chinese student 林躍 speaks four lines of Chinese dialogue.

ja.summary: 英語の軽快な取り戻しアドベンチャー。ジェニーは荷物の返品を忘れ、郵便局が閉まる前に駆けつけなければならない——が、荷物は勝手に移動し続け、局員は彼女の返品にもう慣れっこで、追跡の果ては「地獄」へ。9マップ・111行の台詞。トルワースとキングストン大学は実在のロンドンの地名で、中国人留学生・林躍の中国語台詞も4行ある。

rise-of-shinigami.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Shinigami Chronicles TTRPG, Rain Code's Shinigami, Shin Megami Tensei If... are unrelated); 4 maps / 66 events / 241 Portuguese dialogue lines in-repo (Cidade, Parque, Pós-Morte, Universidade); README plot: a Shinigami warrior seeks revenge after being betrayed by his partner in one of the hardest battles of his life; the player meets new characters, trains, and fights through the city, park and afterlife ('um mundo habitado por almas perdidas e reinado pelos deuses da morte: os Shinigamis'), ending in a final battle against the coordinator ('Derrotou Coordenador' switch); 5 battles; repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ライズ・オブ・シニガミ

zh-Hans.summary: 葡萄牙语奇幻 RPG：死神战士 Matheus 在人生最艰难的一战中遭搭档背叛，决意复仇。玩家穿越城市、公园、死后世界与大学，结识新角色、刻苦训练，最终与协调者决一死战。4 张地图、241 行对白。

en.summary: A Portuguese fantasy RPG: Matheus, a Shinigami warrior, seeks revenge after being betrayed by his partner in one of the hardest battles of his life. The player travels through the city, the park, the afterlife and the university, meeting new characters and training, toward a final battle against the coordinator. 4 maps, 241 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のファンタジーRPG。死神の戦士マテウスは、人生で最も過酷な戦いで相方に裏切られ、復讐を誓う。プレイヤーは街、公園、死後の世界、大学を巡り、新たな仲間と出会い、鍛錬を重ね、コーディネーターとの最終決戦へ向かう。4マップ・241行の台詞。

road-to-joshsdale.assessmentNote: No external traces found (the Josh Hallaran / 8-Bit Adventures interview is unrelated); 13 maps / 128 events / 187 English dialogue lines in-repo (map names are all defaults MAP001..MAP012, but content is real); a running gag where everyone is named Josh ('Hi, I'm Josh!' / 'Hi Josh.'), a memorial to fallen adventurers, healer Josh, a key hidden inside a book labelled 'Josh', a secret teddy bear, and a Credits map (36 lines, 'Idea for the game from Josh'); 13 battles, 1 shop, 4 choices; repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ロード・トゥ・ジョシュデール

zh-Hans.summary: 英语喜剧 RPG：人人都叫 Josh 的小镇之旅——“Hi, I'm Josh!”“Hi Josh.”的问候此起彼伏，路上有阵亡冒险者纪念碑、治愈师 Josh、藏在《Josh 著》书里的钥匙与一只秘密泰迪熊，最后还有一幅致谢地图。13 张地图、187 行对白、13 场战斗。

en.summary: An English comedy RPG: a journey to a town where everyone is named Josh — 'Hi, I'm Josh!' and 'Hi Josh.' echo everywhere, past a memorial to fallen adventurers, healer Josh, a key hidden inside a book labelled 'Josh', a secret teddy bear, and a Credits map. 13 maps, 187 dialogue lines, 13 battles.

ja.summary: 英語のコメディRPG。誰もがジョシュという名の町への旅——「Hi, I'm Josh!」「Hi Josh.」の挨拶があちこちで交わされ、戦死した冒険者の記念碑、回復役のジョシュ、『ジョシュ著』の本に隠された鍵、秘密のテディベア、そしてクレジットマップへ。13マップ・187行の台詞・13戦闘。

rods.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Tibia rods, Terraria battlerods, ROTRDS are unrelated); 3 maps / 17 events / 1 dialogue line in-repo (a variable display '\V[9]') — but the substance is in the event systems, verified by full event-command profiles: class selection (Herói / Guerreira / Curandeira / Arqueiro), a real-time action battle system (parallel-process enemy AI: Porco, Slami, fantasma, Minotauro; initiative rolls, damage numbers, HP bars, hotbar, battle bars), level-up stat choices (HP / defesa), a shop, inventory/HUD scripts, and 3 maps connected by a Portal; 0 standard battles (combat is event-driven), 1 shop, 3 choices; no story, no quest text, no ending — a complete playable loop (pick a class, fight 4 enemy types incl. a Minotaur boss, level up, buy gear), kept as a prototype (cf. MQ-041 Branded Shadow; contrast MQ-127 fighting game, a single battle then Game Over, flipped); system text is Portuguese, languages [pt]; repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 葡萄牙语动作 RPG 原型：没有剧情对白，玩法全在事件系统里——四职业选择（英雄/女战士/治疗师/弓箭手）、实时动作战斗系统（猪、史莱姆、幽灵与牛头怪四种敌人，先攻掷骰、伤害数字、血条、快捷栏与战斗条）、升级属性选择、商店与物品栏，3 张地图由传送门相连。

en.summary: A Portuguese action-RPG prototype: no story dialogue — the substance is in the event systems: four-class selection (Hero / Warrior / Healer / Archer), a real-time action battle system (pig, slime, ghost and Minotaur enemies with initiative rolls, damage numbers, HP bars, hotbar and battle bars), level-up stat choices, a shop and an inventory/HUD, across 3 maps connected by a Portal.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のアクションRPGプロトタイプ。ストーリー台詞はなく、内容はすべてイベントシステムにある——4職業選択（英雄／女戦士／治療師／弓使い）、リアルタイム・アクションバトル（豚・スライム・幽霊・ミノタウロスの4種の敵、先攻ロール、ダメージ数値、HPバー、ホットバー、戦闘バー）、レベルアップ時の能力値選択、ショップとインベントリ／HUD。ポータルでつながる3マップ。

siren-isle.assessmentNote: Real external evidence: itch.io page chifle.itch.io/siren-isle — 'Mischief travels to a desolate island in hopes of aiding their grandfather and saving him from what his beloved town has turned into'; Rated 4.5/5 (8 total ratings); RPG Maker Horror Game Jam #4: Song of the Sea; 'Siren Isle Massive Update/Finished Version! Jul 24, 2024'. Identity confirmed against the indexed build: protagonist is Mischief (Actor 1) and the intro letter is from grandfather 'Peepaw' ('I hope you're doing well. It's been too long since you've last visited'). 37 maps / 253 events / 576 English dialogue lines in-repo (SirenIsle_TownMap, Grandpa's House 111 lines, Docks, Shore, Doctors, Convenience Store; hiding mechanics 'Hide here?', killer triggers TriggerDaKilla/DaKillaRunning, Day1/Day2 system, dreams, Bad End + Ending; item combining — crafted Makeshift Torch); 0 battles, 49 choices; gameTitle empty, originalTitle 'Siren Isle' from the old meta title field, verified by Map006 'SirenIsle_TownMap' + the itch page. Rating left blank (8 ratings is too thin a sample, cf. Crimpo Quest 5.0/3 and Kin's Chronicle 10 Steam reviews, both unscored); popularity 3 (itch page + 8 ratings + jam entry + finished version). Developers are the 6 itch-credited authors; the indexed build is hosted by eml17028 (not among the credited authors). Repo 0 stars.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语恐怖冒险：Mischief 收到祖父 Peepaw 的来信，前往一座荒凉小岛——小镇已经变了样，镇民也变了。玩家在小镇、码头、医生诊所与祖父家之间躲避杀手、组合道具点燃火把，在梦境与坏结局之间寻找真相。37 张地图、576 行对白；RPG Maker 恐怖游戏 Jam 第 4 届（海洋之歌）参赛作。

en.summary: An English horror adventure: Mischief receives a letter from grandfather Peepaw and travels to a desolate island — the town has changed, and so have its people. The player hides from a killer across the town, docks, doctors' offices and Grandpa's house, combines items to craft torches, and searches for the truth between dreams and a bad ending. 37 maps, 576 dialogue lines; an entry in RPG Maker Horror Game Jam #4: Song of the Sea.

ja.summary: 英語のホラーアドベンチャー。ミスチーフは祖父ピーポーからの手紙を受け取り、寂れた島へ向かう——町は変わり果て、人々も変わってしまった。プレイヤーは町、埠頭、医院、祖父の家を巡り、殺人者から隠れ、アイテムを組み合わせて松明を作り、夢とバッドエンドの狭間で真実を探る。37マップ・576行の台詞。RPGツクール・ホラーゲームジャム第4回「海の歌」参加作。

rusel-prototype.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Archeia's itch profile exists but lists no RUSEL page; Steam 'Rus: source' is unrelated); 15 maps / 158 events / 3446 English dialogue lines in-repo (MAIN HUB, THE ROSE PALACE, VIP TEST, APPLEGATE TEST 1453 lines, LOLI SHOP TEST 909 lines, LAB TEST, SLUMS, CITY HALL, STONE CAVE TEST); health/longevity/karma/reputation systems tracked by the GUIDE, jobs (food deliveries, apple picking, shovelling), a token economy to reach Lady Rose (deliver the Red Pill package — it has adverse effects if taken), and a plague quest (find the cave source, get a special weapon, cure via the lab's rat tails + boss blood); romance subplot with Loli, the mayor's granddaughter who runs the shop ('Do you love me, Loli?', kisses on the cheek, 'restrained passion'); maps carry author 'TEST' suffixes and ROSE PALACE TEST duplicates THE ROSE PALACE verbatim — parallel test builds of the same areas, not separate games; the quest chains and GUIDE/stats systems connect them. 5 battles, 14 shops, 224 choices. nsfw false — 'dick' hits are insults ('You were pretty much a dick to me, dude'), 'kiss' hits are romance scenes only (a kiss used to distract Loli while unclasping her necklace — a rogue quest action, no sexual content); the drug-dealer villain Slanger ('We won't buy or sell your crappy drugs') is mentioned only. Repo 1 star; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ルーセル・プロトタイプ

zh-Hans.summary: 英语生活模拟 RPG 原型：陌生人来到苹果门镇，靠健康、寿命、业报与声望四项数值过活——给 Penelope 送食品、摘苹果、铲雪打工，攒代币觐见蔷薇宫的 Rose 女士（代送红药丸包裹），再深入洞穴寻找瘟疫源头。与镇长孙女、开店的 Loli 还有一段恋情。15 张地图、3446 行对白。

en.summary: An English life-sim RPG prototype: a stranger arrives in Applegate and lives by health, longevity, karma and reputation — delivering food for Penelope, picking apples, shovelling snow for pay, earning tokens to reach Lady Rose of the Rose Palace (delivering her Red Pill package), then delving into the caves to find the plague's source. A romance subplot follows Loli, the mayor's granddaughter who runs the shop. 15 maps, 3,446 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語の生活シミュレーションRPGプロトタイプ。見知らぬ旅人がアップルゲートに辿り着き、健康・寿命・カルマ・評判の数値で生きていく——ペネロペへの食料配達、リンゴ摘み、雪かきの仕事で稼ぎ、トークンを集めてローズ宮殿のローズ夫人へ（赤い錠剤の小包を届ける）、そして洞窟で疫病の源を探る。町長の孫娘で店を営むロリとの恋愛模様も。15マップ・3446行の台詞。

sanctuary.assessmentNote: No external traces found (SanctuaryRPG, the shyboytm itch 'Sanctuary', Tomomi Hime's Sanctuary of the Eternal Dragon are all unrelated); 20 maps / 320 events / 884 English dialogue lines in-repo (three facility levels: Robotics, Medbay, Storage; robot Whiskers; pressure levels, ventilation checks, SUPER charge stations; EndingCutscene + EndingBridge maps); 0 standard battles — combat is event-driven (disruptor projectiles, stun/invisibility/dash abilities: 'lvl1complete', 'invisOn', 'canDash', 'canStun', 'npcStunned1' switches), so genres [adventure] not [rpg] (cf. MQ-075), mechanics [stealth, action]; 14 choices. README: CMPUT 250 project by Pawsible Studios (Alan Ogaranko, Ashley Na, Chris Xu, Daniel Asimiakwini, Danny Astle, Max Zang, Nikhil Nayyar; EP Dave Goel). Note: Map005/011/013 are listed in MapInfos but their files are 404 on both GitHub and the mirror (unused maps). Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语科幻潜行动作游戏：阿尔伯塔大学 CMPUT 250 课程作品，Pawsible Studios 团队制作。玩家潜入一座设施的三层区域（机器人区、医疗舱、储藏区），用干扰器射弹、隐身、冲刺与眩晕能力对付机器人 Whiskers 等守卫，完成通风检查、解除压力警报，走向结局。20 张地图、884 行对白。

en.summary: An English sci-fi stealth action game: a University of Alberta CMPUT 250 course project by Pawsible Studios. The player infiltrates three levels of a facility (Robotics, Medbay, Storage), using disruptor projectiles, invisibility, dash and stun abilities against robot guards like Whiskers, completing ventilation checks and clearing pressure alarms toward an ending. 20 maps, 884 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語のSFステルス・アクションゲーム。アルバータ大学CMPUT 250の授業作品で、Pawsible Studiosチーム制作。プレイヤーは施設の3層（ロボティクス／メッドベイ／ストレージ）に潜入し、ディスラプター弾、透明化、ダッシュ、スタン能力でウィスカーズらロボット警備をかわし、換気チェックと圧力アラーム解除をこなして結末へ。20マップ・884行の台詞。

scary-inc.assessmentNote: No external traces found; 5 maps / 20 events / 52 English dialogue lines in-repo (Starting Events, Prequel Intro, Potaro Town, PC's home, plus a DEBUG_MAP); name selection at the start; a hacker calls ('I've hacked into your phone... We've been kidnapped, Scary Inc. as a whole'), Max is held captive in Prolail Village, the player meets Kaylee in their home ('My friends have been kidnapped, no doubt about yours have too'); 13 Actors; a Monsters, Inc.-inspired fan game (Scary Inc, monsters, mafia member NPC); repo 2 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语喜剧 RPG：《怪兽电力公司》风格的同人游戏——吓人公司的怪物们一夜之间全被绑架，只剩玩家一人。一通黑客来电指引方向：Max 被囚禁在 Prolail 村。玩家穿过 Potaro 镇、回到自己家中（透支的银行信件、欠缴的账单、空酒瓶墙、无人出席的生日派对），结识同样在寻友的 Kaylee，踏上营救之旅。5 张地图、52 行对白。

en.summary: An English comedy RPG in the style of Monsters, Inc.: the monsters of Scary Inc. have all been kidnapped overnight, leaving only the player. A hacker's call points the way — Max is held captive in Prolail Village. The player crosses Potaro Town, returns home (overdrawn bank letters, unpaid bills, a wall of empty beer bottles, a birthday party nobody attended) and meets Kaylee, who is also searching for her kidnapped friends. 5 maps, 52 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語のコメディRPG。『モンスターズ・インク』風のファンゲーム——スケアリー社のモンスターたちが一夜にして全員誘拐され、残されたのはプレイヤーだけ。ハッカーからの電話が手がかりを示す。マックスはプロレイル村に囚われている。プレイヤーはポタロの町を抜け、自宅（残高不足の銀行からの手紙、未払いの請求書、空きビールの壁、誰も来なかった誕生日パーティー）に戻り、同じく友人を探すケイリーと出会う。5マップ・52行の台詞。

scholars-journey.assessmentNote: No external traces found (StudyRPG's plan name and Steam's 'Scholar' spelling game are unrelated); 19 maps / 247 events / 196 dialogue lines in-repo (M1-Westwood Town, home, cafe, laundry shop, 7/11, hospital, school hallway/classroom/library; 64 transfers); dialogue is mostly Tagalog (130/196 lines carry Tagalog markers — 'Goodmorning! may kailangan ka bang bilhin?', 'salamat sa pagtulong mo anak sa pag hanap') with English mixed in ('Go to the registrar.', 'Good morning po!'), so languages corrected from old [en, tl] to [tl, en] (Tagalog dominant); quests: find a neighbour's lost dog, ask the registrar which section/program; repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: スカラーズ・ジャーニー

zh-Hans.summary: 菲律宾校园生活冒险：以他加禄语为主、间杂英语的对白，讲述 Westwood 镇一名学生的日常——在家、咖啡馆、洗衣店、7/11、医院与学校之间穿梭，帮邻居寻找走失的爱犬，再去教务处问清自己分到哪个班、读哪个专业。19 张地图、196 行对白。

en.summary: A Filipino school-life adventure, mostly in Tagalog with English mixed in: a student's daily life across Westwood Town — home, a cafe, the laundry shop, a 7/11, the hospital and the school — helping a neighbour find her lost dog, then asking the registrar which section and program they belong to. 19 maps, 196 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: フィリピンの学園生活アドベンチャー。タガログ語中心で英語も混ざる台詞。ウェストウッドの町で、家、カフェ、ランドリー、セブンイレブン、病院、学校を行き来しながら、隣人の迷子の犬を探し、教務課で自分たちのクラスと専攻を尋ねる学生の日常を描く。19マップ・196行の台詞。

school-of-survival.assessmentNote: No external traces found (the Korean RPG Maker XP 'School' and other same-name games are unrelated); 67 maps / 441 events / 436 English dialogue lines in-repo (Day 1–5 map sets: office/school/hallway/classroom/highway/home/stalls/bathrooms/stores per day, plus IntroScene and an ENDING map; 194 transfers); daily tasks tracked by switches (BallpenQuest, DayOneTaskOne/Two … Day5Task1, 'MeetTheAdviser'); the game opens with a phone alarm ('It's been months since I heard the ol' familiar default alarm sound of my iPhone… 6:30?') and ends with a progress report to the teacher; repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: スクール・オブ・サバイバル

zh-Hans.summary: 英语校园生活 RPG：五天结构，每天在办公室、学校、走廊、教室、公路、家与摊位之间完成导师布置的任务（钢笔任务、进度汇报），从 iPhone 闹钟声中醒来（“好几个月没听到这熟悉的默认闹钟声了……6:30？”），熬过五天迎来结局。67 张地图、436 行对白。

en.summary: An English school-life RPG built on a five-day structure: each day the player moves between the office, school, hallway, classroom, highway, home and stalls to finish the adviser's tasks (a ballpen quest, progress reports), waking to an iPhone alarm ('It's been months since I heard the ol' familiar default alarm sound of my iPhone… 6:30?') and surviving five days to an ending. 67 maps, 436 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語の学園生活RPG。5日間の構造で、毎日オフィス、学校、廊下、教室、ハイウェイ、自宅、屋台を巡り、指導教員の課題（ボールペン探し、進捗報告）をこなす。iPhoneのアラームで目覚め（「あの懐かしいデフォルトのアラーム音を聞くのは何ヶ月ぶりだろう……6時30分？」）、5日間を生き抜いてエンディングへ。67マップ・436行の台詞。

sci-high.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Shrink 'High is a different game); 27 maps / 165 events / 305 English dialogue lines in-repo (Computer Lab, Intro, DUNGEON - CSS / HTML / Python / DS & ALGO, Main Building 1st/2nd Floor, Upgrade Room/Library, Office, Classroom, minigame maps for Noah, Evelyn, Tina and Selena; 102 transfers); Principal Marinelle's enrolment speech introduces the HTML/CSS/Python courses and a bonus course; dungeon bosses taunt in programming terms ('Oh, you thought installing one package was enough?', 'Your syntax is correct, but your logic is flawed!'); a stats-upload consent prompt records playtime, average clear time, total mistakes and rank; switches include WinBattle, Combat, Boss, DungeonFinished, 'Quiz Active Timer', HTML_CLEAR / CSS_CLEAR / PYTHON_CLEAR. Mirror-only entry (no sourceRepo, no sourceHeadSha): developers left empty — the entry id suggests jsnb21 as host, but authorship is unconfirmed, so it is not asserted. Rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语教育 RPG：校长 Marinelle 欢迎玩家入学 SCI-HIGH，在这里学习 HTML、CSS 与 Python（通关后解锁一门奖励课程）。玩家在赛博学习系统里闯测验地牢（CSS/HTML/Python/数据结构与算法），与用编程术语挑衅的 Boss 战斗（“语法没错，但逻辑错了！”），再玩 Noah、Evelyn、Tina 与 Selena 的小游戏。27 张地图、305 行对白。

en.summary: An English educational RPG: Principal Marinelle enrols the player at SCI-HIGH to learn HTML, CSS and Python (with a bonus course unlocked on completion). The player fights through quiz dungeons (CSS, HTML, Python, Data Structures & Algorithms) in the CyberSpace Learning System, facing boss enemies that taunt in programming terms ('Your syntax is correct, but your logic is flawed!'), and plays minigames with Noah, Evelyn, Tina and Selena. 27 maps, 305 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語の教育RPG。マリネル校長がプレイヤーをSCI-HIGHに入学させ、HTML、CSS、Pythonを学ばせる（修了するとボーナス講座が解放）。サイバースペース学習システムでクイズダンジョン（CSS／HTML／Python／データ構造とアルゴリズム）に挑み、プログラミング用語で挑発するボスと戦い（「構文は正しいが、論理が間違っている！」）、ノア、エヴリン、ティナ、セレナのミニゲームも遊べる。27マップ・305行の台詞。

secret-gpt.assessmentNote: No external traces found for this specific game; 2 maps / 8 events / 15 English dialogue lines in-repo (Pilot town; the second map, Main character house, is empty); the README describes 'an immersive detective role-playing game where you step into the shoes of a modern-day detective… Dynamic Storytelling: Harness the power of cutting-edge AI technology' and the event data carries GPT plugin commands (codes 357/657); the indexed build's one complete loop is a fox-fetch quest — accept ('Here's a quest for you. Do you wanna take it?'), catch the fox ('You just caught the fox!'), collect scattered coins ('You collected 1 Coin!'), deliver it ('Ohhh, you found it! Thanks for bringing it back'); kept as a prototype (cf. MQ-137 game1, MQ-147 M00NL16H7 — thin dialogue but a complete loop; contrast MQ-149 1-minute demo flip). nsfw false — the 'fuck' keyword hit is 'Fuck off then!' (refusing the quest), plain profanity, not sexual content. Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语 AI 侦探 RPG 原型：README 称之为“由 GPT 驱动动态叙事的沉浸式侦探角色扮演游戏”，玩家扮演现代侦探，在充满阴谋与犯罪的城市里破案。当前收录版本只有一个完整的微型循环：试点镇上接下找狐狸的委托，抓回狐狸、捡回散落的金币、交还失主。2 张地图、15 行对白。

en.summary: An English AI-powered detective RPG prototype: the README describes 'an immersive detective role-playing game' with dynamic storytelling driven by GPT, casting the player as a modern-day detective in a city of intrigue and crime. The indexed build holds one complete micro-loop in Pilot town: take a quest to retrieve a fox, catch it, collect the coins it scattered, and deliver it back to its owner. 2 maps, 15 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語のAI探偵RPGプロトタイプ。READMEは「GPTによるダイナミックな物語生成」を掲げる没入型探偵RPGで、プレイヤーは陰謀と犯罪に満ちた街の現代の探偵となる。収録版にはパイロットタウンでの小さな一連のクエストが1つある。キツネ探しの依頼を受け、キツネを捕まえ、散らばったコインを集め、飼い主に届ける。2マップ・15行の台詞。

senja-terakhir.assessmentNote: No external traces found; 23 maps / 208 events / 523 Indonesian dialogue lines in-repo (Jakarta, Kamp Militer, Rumah lt2, Barak, Desa 224 lines, Markas Pemerintahan, Penjara, Sewer, Stone Cave; 262/523 lines carry Indonesian markers); Ardi reports to his father ('(Aku harus segera laporkan kejadian tadi malam kepada Ayah.)'), Sari's father was arrested by the military for supporting the red party ('Ayahku ditangkap oleh militer karena dia mendukung partai merah'), the player frees prisoners ('Kalian bebas!' / 'Kami... tidak percaya ini terjadi.' / 'Terima kasih nak'); three endings (Ending 1/2/3 switches). Both forks are the same game: identical versionId (1181066), identical map lists and identical counts — the Altrisk repo is the original, DaffaDaff a copy; both listed as instances. Repos 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 印尼语剧情 RPG：Ardi 向父亲汇报昨夜发生的事，Sari 的父亲因支持红党被军方逮捕。玩家在军营、村庄、监狱、下水道与石洞之间穿行，营救囚犯（“你们自由了！”“谢谢你，孩子”），走向三个结局之一。23 张地图、523 行对白。

en.summary: An Indonesian drama RPG: Ardi reports last night's events to his father, while Sari's father has been arrested by the military for supporting the red party. The player moves between the military camp, the village, the prison, the sewer and a stone cave, freeing prisoners ('Kalian bebas!' / 'Terima kasih nak') toward one of three endings. 23 maps, 523 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: インドネシア語のドラマRPG。アルディは昨夜の出来事を父に報告し、サリの父は赤い党を支持したとして軍に逮捕された。プレイヤーは野営地、村、監獄、下水道、石の洞窟を巡り、囚人を解放しながら（「君たちは自由だ！」「ありがとう、坊や」）3つのエンディングのいずれかへ向かう。23マップ・523行の台詞。

settlement.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Forge of Empires Vikings settlements and a Unity Ragnarök design doc are unrelated); 2 maps / 33 events / 24 English dialogue lines in-repo (MAIN, INTRO) — but the substance is in the event systems, verified by full event-command profiles: 70 condition branches, 213 variable operations, 3 shops, worker hiring (Worker1S/2S/3S switches, 'I'll work for you!' / 'You don't have enough gold!'), a crop system (CROPA switch) and a gold economy ('20\G were found!'); the player is Ragnar (Actor 1). Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语定居点经营模拟：对白只有 24 行，玩法全在事件系统里——雇佣工人（“我来为你工作！”“你没有足够的金币！”）、三家商店、作物系统与金币经济，在主地图上一点点建起定居点。玩家是 Ragnar。2 张地图、33 个事件。

en.summary: An English settlement management simulation: only 24 dialogue lines — the substance is in the event systems: hiring workers ('I'll work for you!' / 'You don't have enough gold!'), three shops, a crop system and a gold economy, building up a settlement on the main map. The player is Ragnar. 2 maps, 33 events.

ja.summary: 英語の入植地経営シミュレーション。台詞は24行のみで、内容はすべてイベントシステムにある——労働者の雇用（「君のために働くよ！」「金が足りない！」）、3軒の店、作物システムと金貨経済。メインマップで入植地を築いていく。プレイヤーはラグナル。2マップ・33イベント。

shadows.assessmentNote: The RPG Maker adaptation itself has no external trace, but its source material is documented: 'Shadows' is the first part of Traveller Double Adventure 1: Shadows/Annic Nova (GDW, 1980, Marc W. Miller; Wikipedia; Grognardia retrospective) — the crew of a starship detects a strange structure of three hollow pyramids on Yorbund, is fired on by an energy weapon, and must land to disable it. The indexed build matches that premise exactly (map names: MAP001-Falling Star Main, MAP004-The Pyramids, MAP005-Power Plant, MAP007-Deep Level, MAP013-Fuel Chamber; switches: 'Laser fired', 'Defenses off', 'Area 34 mural seen', 'Fracture Point'). README: 'A Traveller Adventure, v1.0b… based on previously published material, and as such is distributed free of charge. You may give it away but not sell it.' 11 maps / 213 events / 487 English dialogue lines in-repo; turn-based combat per the README. Popularity 2 (niche TTRPG provenance, no spread of the adaptation itself); rating blank — the source material's reputation is not the adaptation's. No relations entry: the 1980 adventure is not in the registry. Repo 2 stars.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语科幻 RPG：经典桌游《Traveller》1980 年冒险模组《Shadows》的 RPG Maker 改编版（README 注明“改编自已出版素材，免费发行，不得出售”）。Falling Star 号船员在 Yorbund 轨道上发现三座中空金字塔构成的奇异建筑，靠近时遭能量武器开火，只得着陆探索金字塔、发电厂与深层区域，设法关闭武器。11 张地图、487 行对白。

en.summary: An English sci-fi RPG: an RPG Maker adaptation of the classic Traveller tabletop adventure 'Shadows' (GDW Double Adventure 1, 1980, Marc W. Miller) — the README notes it is 'based on previously published material, and as such is distributed free of charge. You may give it away but not sell it.' The crew of the Falling Star detects a strange structure of three hollow pyramids in orbit around Yorbund, is fired on by an energy weapon, and must land to explore the pyramids, the power plant and the deep levels to disable it. 11 maps, 487 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語のSF RPG。クラシックなテーブルトークRPG『トラベラー』の1980年の冒険モジュール『シャドウズ』（GDWダブル・アドベンチャー第1弾、マーク・W・ミラー作）のRPGツクール版（READMEに「既刊素材を基にしており、無料配布。譲渡は可、販売は不可」と明記）。フォーリング・スター号の乗員はヨーバンド軌道上で3つの中空ピラミッドからなる奇妙な建造物を発見し、エネルギー兵器に撃たれて着陸を余儀なくされ、ピラミッド、発電所、深層部を探索して兵器を停止させる。11マップ・487行の台詞。

shinsan-quest.assessmentNote: No external traces found; 11 maps / 99 events / 250 Japanese dialogue lines in-repo (Shimizu building 8F/7F, Shibuya, Cross building 26F/16F/14F/12F, opening, Higashiguchi office; switches for the four badge stones ハーモス/ビズ/スタンバイ/キャリトレ); colleagues celebrate Shin-san's birthday ('誕生日おめでとうございます！！！') and the badge stones are the goal ('ハーモス、ビズ、スタンバイ、キャリトレの石が必要', '全部あるなら開けましょう'). The old meta title 'RealQuest ~真クエスト~' could not be verified anywhere (gameTitle, index.html title and list title all say SHINSAN QUEST), so it is not adopted as a title or alias. Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 日语生日礼物 RPG：同事们为上班族真先生庆祝生日（“生日快乐！！！”），他要在清水大厦 8 楼、涩谷与 Cross 大厦之间奔走，集齐ハーモス、ビズ、スタンバイ、キャリトレ四枚徽章石，打开前路。11 张地图、250 行对白。

en.summary: A Japanese birthday-gift RPG: office worker Shin-san's colleagues celebrate his birthday ('Happy birthday!!!') and he must cross the Shimizu building's 8th floor, Shibuya and the Cross building to gather four badge stones (Harmony, Biz, Standby and Carry-trade) and open the way. 11 maps, 250 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 日本語のバースデーギフトRPG。同僚たちが会社員シンさんの誕生日を祝い（「誕生日おめでとうございます！！！」）、清水ビル8F、渋谷、クロスビルを行き来してハーモス、ビズ、スタンバイ、キャリトレの4つのバッジの石を集め、道を開く。11マップ・250行の台詞。

shrek-vs-warroten.assessmentNote: No external traces found; 2 maps / 29 events / 56 Spanish dialogue lines (11 unique — the 5-line intro scene repeats across NPCs) in-repo (Exterior/Interior Castillo; 4 battle-processing events; defeat switches wa_derrotado, rr_derrotado, waS_derrotado, rrS_derrotado, warroten_derrotado); the castle belongs to Waluigi and Robbie Rotten ('Este es el castillo de Waluigi y Robbie Rotten.'), a purple corruption is spreading ('La corrupción morada se está expandiendo a una velocidad preocupante.') and the player must stop it ('Tengo que parar ya esta locura.'). Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: シュレック VS ウォロテン

zh-Hans.summary: 西语喜剧 RPG：瓦路易基与罗比·罗滕的城堡里，紫色腐化正以惊人的速度蔓延，玩家必须阻止这场疯狂（“我必须马上阻止这疯狂”），与城堡的守卫们逐一交战。2 张地图、4 场战斗。

en.summary: A Spanish comedy RPG: in the castle of Waluigi and Robbie Rotten, a purple corruption is spreading at an alarming speed and the player must stop the madness ('I have to stop this madness right now'), fighting the castle's defenders one by one. 2 maps, 4 battles.

ja.summary: スペイン語のコメディRPG。ワルイージとロビー・ロッテンの城で、紫の腐敗が驚くべき速さで広がっており、プレイヤーはこの狂気を止めなければならない（「この狂気を今すぐ止めなきゃ」）。城の守衛たちと次々に戦う。2マップ・4回の戦闘。

sierquest.assessmentNote: Covered by two major Japanese outlets in Nov 2015: ITmedia NetLab (2015/11/18, 'IT業界の社員がシステムバグのモンスターを倒す謎ゲーム「SIerクエスト」の闇が深い') and GIGAZINE (2015/11/16, English edition) — a '3分ほどでクリアできるクソゲー' (about 3 minutes to clear) made by programmer Soichiro Yoshimura as an RPG Maker MV beta-test sample, protagonist SIer Tanaka Shotaro fighting bug/error-message monsters; a sequel, SIerQuest 2, appeared in Dec 2015 (GIGAZINE addendum). In-repo: 2 maps / 7 events / 26 Japanese dialogue lines / 2 battles (屋外 / 会社; opening switch オープニング終了; hero 田中正太郎; 'ここは、システムインテグレーターのI社。' / '僕は、田中正太郎。システムインテグレーターだ。'). Repo 16 stars, official page http://sifue.github.io/SIerQuest/ (cited by GIGAZINE). Popularity 4 (two major media articles + sequel + 16 stars); rating blank — media coverage is not a review score.

zh-Hans.summary: 日语喜剧 RPG：系统集成商田中正太郎每天要独自包揽程序员、系统工程师、客服与测试的全部工作，与化身怪物的系统 Bug（NullPointerException 等报错信息）战斗。作者吉村聪一郎用 RPG Maker MV 测试版随手做的 3 分钟小品，2015 年 11 月登上ねとらぼ与 GIGAZINE；同年 12 月出了续作 SIerQuest 2。2 张地图、26 行对白。

en.summary: A Japanese comedy RPG: system integrator Tanaka Shotaro has to handle every job himself — programmer, systems engineer, customer support, tester — fighting system bugs that appear as monsters (NullPointerException and other error messages). A 3-minute joke game made by Soichiro Yoshimura with the RPG Maker MV beta, covered by ITmedia NetLab and GIGAZINE in November 2015; a sequel, SIerQuest 2, followed that December. 2 maps, 26 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 日本語のコメディRPG。システムインテグレーターの田中正太郎はプログラマー、システムエンジニア、カスタマーサポート、テスターの業務をすべて自分でこなす日々を送り、「NullPointerException」などのエラーメッセージの姿をしたシステムバグのモンスターと戦う。吉村聡一郎氏がRPGツクールMVのベータテスト版で試しに作った3分でクリアできる一発ネタゲームで、2015年11月にねとらぼとGIGAZINEで紹介され、同年12月には続編『SIerクエスト2』も登場した。2マップ・26行の台詞。

skere.assessmentNote: No external traces found; 11 maps / 62 events / 88 Spanish dialogue lines (84 unique) / 1 battle in-repo (Intro, Salón del manga, Mercadona1, zona perdida, Cole aparcamiento; battle counter variable Contador de batallas); crude-humour school/manga-store adventure — Smash / Pokémon Go / Love Live jokes ('Bueno os dejo pasar pero soy mejor que ustedes al smash :V', 'Os gano en el Pokémon Go, os gano en el smash', 'tomad también una chapita de love live uwu'), profanity throughout. gameTitle and index.html title both say SKERE; the old meta title 'CALLATE KEVIN' matches only the repo name, so it is not adopted as a title or alias. Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 西语喜剧 RPG：粗口与恶搞齐飞的校园冒险——漫画沙龙、Mercadona 超市、失落区域与学校停车场之间穿梭，NPC 满口 Smash、宝可梦 Go 与 Love Live 的梗（“我 Smash 比你们强，宝可梦 Go 比你们强”），再顺手送你一枚 Love Live 徽章。11 张地图、88 行对白。

en.summary: A Spanish comedy RPG: a crude-humour school adventure across the manga lounge, a Mercadona supermarket, the lost zone and the school car park, with NPCs trading Smash, Pokémon Go and Love Live jokes ('I beat you at Smash, I beat you at Pokémon Go') and handing over a Love Live badge. 11 maps, 88 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: スペイン語のコメディRPG。マンガサロン、メルカドーナ、失われたエリア、学校の駐車場を巡る下品なジョーク満載の学園アドベンチャー。NPCはスマブラ、ポケモンGO、ラブライブのネタで言い合い（「スマブラでもポケモンGOでもお前らに勝つ」）、ラブライブの缶バッジをくれる。11マップ・88行の台詞。

sketched-reflections.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Steam's 'Reflections' and other same-name games are unrelated); 15 maps / 111 events / 7 English dialogue lines in-repo (Cave/Dungeon 1–8, Name, End Screen) — the substance is in the dungeon systems, verified by full event-command profiles: battle-processing events on several floors, spike-damage CommonEvents ('Spike Damage', 'Spike Damage 2'), movement-route puzzles (Map 9 D4_2: 62 move-route events with 404 route commands; Map 11: 14), pickups ('Distractable Stone was found.', 'Lamp of Confidence was found.'), a name-entry map ('Write your name.') and an end screen ('Game made by Angel Flores', 'Plugins made by TheoAllen, LoneWolf, and Galv.'). Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: スケッチド・リフレクションズ

zh-Hans.summary: 英语地牢探索 RPG：对白只有 7 行，玩法全在地牢系统里——八层地牢逐层深入，尖刺伤害、移动路线谜题（D4_2 一张图就有 404 条移动路线指令）、可拾取的“分心石”与“自信之灯”，从写下名字开始，到通关画面结束。15 张地图、111 个事件。

en.summary: An English dungeon-crawler RPG: only 7 dialogue lines — the substance is in the dungeon systems: eight dungeon floors to descend, spike damage, movement-route puzzles (one map alone, D4_2, carries 404 move-route commands), pickups such as the 'Distractable Stone' and the 'Lamp of Confidence', from a name-entry screen to an end screen. 15 maps, 111 events.

ja.summary: 英語のダンジョン探索RPG。台詞は7行のみで、内容はすべてダンジョンシステムにある——8層のダンジョンを下り、トゲのダメージ、移動ルートのパズル（D4_2の1マップだけで404の移動ルート命令）、「気をそらす石」や「自信のランプ」といった拾い物。名前入力画面から始まり、エンド画面で終わる。15マップ・111イベント。

skullseeker.assessmentNote: No external traces found (Steam/GOG 'Ruins Seeker' and other same-name games are unrelated); 22 maps / 157 events / 334 Portuguese dialogue lines in-repo (Ilha 1–3, Praia, Vila, Floresta, Casa 1–4; switches 'Velho túmulo na praia', 'Marcos Carpinteiro', 'Ordem para pegar itens'; wood-collection counter variable Contator madeiras); the README states it was made in RPG Maker MV for the 3rd-unit grade of the SISTEMAS MULTIMÍDIA course ('Jogo feito em RPG Maker MV como parte da nota da 3ª unidade da disciplina de SISTEMAS MULTIMÍDIA'); the story opens on the grandmother's death ('Eliza: Fiquei sabendo sobre sua avó. Sinto muito...', 'Sua vó parecia querer falar algo a você antes de partir.'). Repo 1 star; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 葡语 RPG：大学多媒体课程作业——祖母去世后，主角回到宁静的村庄（“你的祖母总说这随时可能发生”），在三个岛屿的海滩、村庄与森林之间探索，帮木匠 Marcos 收集木材，追寻祖母临终前想说的话。22 张地图、334 行对白。

en.summary: A Portuguese RPG made as a university multimedia-course project: after the grandmother's death, the protagonist returns to a peaceful village ('Your grandma always said this could happen at any moment') and explores the beaches, villages and forests of three islands, collecting wood for the carpenter Marcos and chasing what the grandmother wanted to say before she died. 22 maps, 334 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のRPG。大学のマルチメディア科目の課題作品——祖母の死後、主人公は平和な村に戻り（「おばあちゃんはいつも、こうなるかもしれないと言っていた」）、3つの島の浜辺、村、森を探索し、大工のマルコスのために木材を集め、祖母が亡くなる前に言いたかったことを追う。22マップ・334行の台詞。

instances.title: Slumberer's Universe
instances.notes: Open-source web port/devbuild of the commercial game (repo 00due/rupuauto-game, branch web).

slumberers-universe.assessmentNote: Commercial game with a multi-platform release: Steam app 2140980, $4.99, released 2025-08-20, 16 achievements, English only (store page verified 2026-11-13); itch.io $5 (fsorsat); Grouvee and TapTap listings; 50gameslike surreal-games list. Steam description (verified): 'Slumberer's Universe tells a story of a grieving middle schooler struggling with loss. Months have passed since Alph's best friend Walter died in a car accident.' — 'A unique turn-based-meets-action battle system that's been praised by players!' The indexed instance is an open-source web port/devbuild (repo README: 'based on the latest Slumberer's Universe source code'); its data matches the commercial game exactly (167 maps / 2432 events / 3553 English dialogue lines; maps house_alph, school, outside_forest, labo, walterDeath, hw_guilt, hw_hell; protagonist Alph, Walter's death, homework/chase sequences). Popularity 6 (commercial multi-platform release + aggregator listings + active updates); rating blank — no review-count evidence retrievable (SteamSpy reports 0 reviews, Steam appreviews endpoint returns 302). The old meta had no languages field and genres [minigame] — corrected by measurement to [en] and [rpg]; the old alias 'Rupu Auto' is only the fork/repo name, not adopted. Repo 1 star.

translatedTitles.ja: スランバラーズ・ユニバース

zh-Hans.summary: 英语心理恐怖 JRPG：中学生 Alph 的好友 Walter 几个月前死于车祸，Alph 始终无法走出这份悲伤。某天，Walter 留下的一件遗物让一连串改变人生的事件开始了——在一个正在消逝的超现实世界里，Alph 必须面对被埋葬的记忆与那个想要抹去的自己。Steam 2025 年 8 月 20 日发售，回合制与动作结合的战斗系统。167 张地图、3553 行对白。

en.summary: An English psychological horror JRPG: months have passed since Alph's best friend Walter died in a car accident, and Alph still cannot overcome the loss. One day, something Walter left behind sets a series of life-changing events in motion — in a strange, fading, surreal world, Alph must confront his buried memories and the part of himself he wanted to erase. Released on Steam on 2025-08-20, with a turn-based-meets-action battle system. 167 maps, 3,553 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語の心理ホラーJRPG。中学生アルフの親友ウォルターが数ヶ月前に交通事故で亡くなり、アルフはその悲しみから立ち直れずにいる。ある日、ウォルターが残したものが人生を変える出来事の連鎖を引き起こす——消えゆく超現実的な世界で、アルフは埋もれた記憶と、消し去りたかった自分自身と向き合わなければならない。Steamで2025年8月20日に発売。ターン制とアクションを組み合わせた戦闘システム。167マップ・3,553行の台詞。

warnings: Contains depictions of suicide and self-harm (per Steam's content description).

smut-summoner.assessmentNote: No external traces found for THIS game — the CageyGames 'Smut Summoner' in search results is a different, unrelated commercial game (450-creature collectathon) and must not be conflated with this GameOff 2022 jam prototype (README: 'GameOff2022 project for Team S*** Storm'). In-repo: 2 maps / 3 events / 0 map dialogue, but the content lives in 40 CommonEvents with 216 English dialogue lines (Start1, ProcessRune, PlayIntro, ProcessReward, RandomDryad/Erinyes/Fairy/Gnome/Goblin/Halfling/Mermaid/Naga/Succubus/Tiefling/Woodelf, DiscoverDryad … DiscoverWoodelf; switches discoveredDryad … discoveredWoodelf; STV_BeastBook plugin); the intro verse confirms the lewd spellbook theme ('Oh, look who's here, a summoner brand new', 'with me it's much more intimate', 'a peek into the naughty and the pervasive'). nsfw true (old meta true, confirmed by CE dialogue). en.summary: An English adult summoner game, a GameOff 2022 jam entry: the player receives a lewd spellbook ('a peek into the naughty and the pervasive'), inscribes a rune and randomly summons a creature — dryad, erinyes, fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, mermaid, naga, succubus, tiefling or wood elf — discovering each one and logging it in the bestiary. The content lives entirely in 40 CommonEvents, 216 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: 英語のアダルト召喚ゲーム。GameOff 2022の参加作品。プレイヤーは下品な魔法の本を手に入れ（「下品で至る所にあるものを覗いてみよう」）、ルーンを刻んでランダムにクリーチャーを召喚する——ドライアド、エリニュス、フェアリー、ノーム、ゴブリン、ハーフリング、マーメイド、ナーガ、サキュバス、ティーフリング、ウッドエルフ。1体ずつ発見して図鑑に記録していく。内容はすべて40のコモンイベントにあり、216行の台詞。

warnings: Explicit sexual content; 18+ only (lewd summoning theme; succubus and other erotic creature summons).

translatedTitles.ja: スナイパー・アンド・ティックル

The author describes it as an erotic RPG (エロRPG).

ja.summary: 日本語の短編スナイパーRPG。スナイパーのライファが魔王城に潜入し、限られた弾薬とグレネードで隠れる・騙す・耐える・狙撃する——敵に捕まるとくすぐりイベントが発生する。34マップ・775イベント、130のコモンイベントがくすぐり演出とボス戦を担う。作者はエロRPGと自称している。

warnings: Tickling fetish content: non-consensual tickling, tentacle restraint and nude bondage scenes; 18+ (author describes the game as an エロRPG).

somna-spores.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/media record; repo desc 'dreammy', no README). In-repo: 3 maps / 24 events / 16 English dialogue lines / 4 transfers / 1 choice, with 'ending' and 'last paragraph' switches — a complete micro-vignette, not a demo of a bigger game: 'By day the village is translucent, shifting gently in the light. Reality appears only at night.', '"Somna Spores," neural spores shed quietly from villagers’ bodies, float briefly through the air, seeking hosts whose minds match their rhythm.', 'Skin might be the ultimate vessel of empathy — you don’t know. But you've become a container for dreams.' The repo root is a hand-written HTML/JS dream site; the RPG Maker MZ data lives in the indexed subdirectory (VisuMZ message-effect plugins). Languages [en] confirmed (16/16 lines; locale zh_TW is the editor default only). Same keep pattern as MQ-155 glancing (single-map micro-narrative with an ending). Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语实验微型小品：失眠的新来者走进一座白天半透明的村庄，夜里村民身上脱落的神经孢子“Somna Spores”悄悄钻进皮肤，在血肉里编织梦境；玩家最终成为他人梦境的容器。3 张地图、16 行对白，有选择与结局。

en.summary: An English experimental micro-vignette: a sleepless newcomer walks into a village that is translucent by day; at night the Somna Spores — neural spores shed from the villagers' bodies — seep into the skin and weave dreams through the flesh, until the player becomes a container for others' dreams. 3 maps, 16 dialogue lines, with a choice and an ending.

ja.summary: 英語の実験的な短編小品。不眠の新参者が昼は半透明の村を歩く。夜になると村民の体からこぼれる神経胞子「Somna Spores」が皮膚に染み込み、肉体の中で夢を織り、プレイヤーはやがて他人の夢の器になる。3マップ・16行の台詞。選択肢とエンディングがある。

sorcery-of-truth.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/media record; 'Sorcery of Truth' + Aspen/EastMarch searches return only the novel 'Sorcery of Thorns' and the 'Sword of Truth' series). In-repo: 26 maps / 1538 events / 589 Portuguese dialogue lines — four artifact bosses with win/lose branches (Naga Queen → Amuleto da Rainha Naga, Acromantula Queen → Anel da Rainha Acromântula, Alpha Werewolf → Bracelete do Lobo Alfa, Minotaur → Cinturão do Minotauro, 'o ultimo artefato'), the village of EastMarch, Kate / Astrid / Medeia, a dream sequence (Sonho de Aspen: 'Você derrotou seu primeiro inimigo.' / 'Então foi só um sonho...'), the letter ('Ele está vivo. Eu sei como achá-lo'), switches 'Liberar Final' / 'Liberar Regiões'. The README states it was made in a game-design class ('Jogo criado na aula de Design de Games') by a 5-person team (Caio Passos, Aline Kato, Diana Rosalem, Estevão Guerra, Bernardo Zampirolo); its typo 'Sorcery of True' is not adopted as an alias. Languages [pt] confirmed. Repo 3 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ソーサリー・オブ・トゥルース

zh-Hans.summary: 葡语奇幻 RPG：主角 Aspen 收到“他还活着，我知道怎么找到他”的来信，与神秘女巫一道寻找失踪的父亲，穿越南加领地、狼人森林与牛头怪沙漠，集齐 Naga 女王的护符、巨蛛女王的戒指、狼王的手镯与牛头怪的腰带四件神器。游戏设计课 5 人小组作品，26 张地图、589 行对白。

en.summary: A Portuguese fantasy RPG: Aspen receives a letter — "He's alive. I know how to find him" — and sets out with a mysterious sorceress to find his missing father, crossing the Naga territory, the werewolf forest and the minotaur desert to collect four artifacts: the Naga Queen's amulet, the Acromantula Queen's ring, the Alpha Werewolf's bracelet and the Minotaur's belt. A five-student game-design class project. 26 maps, 589 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のファンタジーRPG。「彼は生きている。見つけ方がわかる」という手紙を受け取ったアスペンは、謎の魔女とともに失踪した父を探しに出る。ナーガの領地、狼男の森、ミノタウロスの砂漠を巡り、ナーガ女王のアミュレット、巨大蜘蛛女王の指輪、狼王の腕輪、ミノタウロスのベルトの4つの神器を集める。ゲームデザイン授業の5人チーム作品。26マップ・589行の台詞。

sota-beta.assessmentNote: No external traces found for THIS game (no Steam/itch/media record). In-repo: 1 map (Beta_Map) / 26 events / 117 Russian dialogue lines / 8 battles / 6 choices, with a complete tutorial arc — controls intro ('Привет! Добро пожаловать в бету Song of the abyss!'), first mob, recruit Avrora ('Возьми себе в команду Аврору!'), level 10 ascension ('Вы готовы возвысить Авору?'), gacha minigame (crystal, coins; Kal'tsit / Elena / Texas summons — Arknights character names), element skills, ascension choices, a boss warning and a final battle ('Выбери, с кем хочешь сразиться: Ангелом, или быть может... Мной?'), level cap 20, and the explicit disclaimer 'ВНИМАНИЕ: эта игра является демонстрацией игровых механик. То, что будет в финальной (полной) игре может отличаться.' — contentType demo. The full game's name 'Song of the Abyss' comes from the in-game intro (not from a README — the repo has none); translatedTitles.en records it. The itch.io 'Song of the Abyss' is a DIFFERENT game (Stardust_and_Snowflakes yuri VN, Josei Game Jam 2025, protagonist Cnidra the jellyfish mermaid) and must not be conflated. Languages [ru] confirmed (117/117 lines). Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ソング・オブ・ジ・アビス

zh-Hans.summary: 俄语测试版 RPG（“Song of the Abyss”的 Beta 演示）：简短的新手教学——第一场战斗、招募神射手 Avrora、升到 10 级完成升华，再到水晶抽卡（Kal'tsit、Elena、Texas 等角色）、元素技能与最终 Boss 战（二选一：天使，还是“我”）。游戏内明确标注为机制演示版，完整版内容可能不同。1 张地图、117 行对白、8 场战斗。

en.summary: A Russian beta/demo RPG (the beta of "Song of the Abyss"): a short tutorial — the first battle, recruiting the sharpshooter Avrora, levelling her to 10 and ascending her, then a crystal gacha (Kal'tsit, Elena, Texas and others), element skills and a final boss choice (the Angel, or "Me"). The game states in-game that it is a demonstration of the mechanics and the full game may differ. 1 map, 117 dialogue lines, 8 battles.

ja.summary: ロシア語のベータ／デモRPG（「Song of the Abyss」のベータ版）。短いチュートリアル——最初の戦闘、射手アヴローラの仲間入り、レベル10での昇格、水晶ガチャ（カルツィット、エレーナ、テキサスら）、属性スキル、そして最終ボス選択（天使か「私」か）。ゲーム内でメカニクス演示版であることが明記され、正式版とは内容が異なる場合がある。1マップ・117行の台詞・8回の戦闘。

zh-Hans.summary: 俄英双语剧情 RPG：小队受雇远征，为期约 10 天，深入法翁的宝库（“报酬就是从宝库里平分战利品”）；诅咒之月当空，召唤兽与同伴并肩作战，8 场战斗、商店与队伍编成、术语词典。内容全在 120 个公共事件里（1176 行对白），地图文件只负责启动开场。序章分 0–6 场，含部分英文翻译场景。

en.summary: A Russian/English story RPG: a squad is hired for a roughly 10-day expedition into a faun vault ("the reward is an equal share of whatever we bring back"); under a cursed moon, summons and companions fight side by side across 8 battles, with shops, party setup and a glossary. The content lives entirely in 120 CommonEvents (1,176 dialogue lines); the map file only launches the opening. The prologue runs in scenes 0–6, with some scenes translated into English.

ja.summary: ロシア語／英語のストーリーRPG。小隊は約10日間の遠征に雇われ、フォーンの宝物庫へ（「報酬は宝庫から持ち帰ったものを平等に分けること」）。呪われた月の下、召喚獣と仲間が並んで戦う。8回の戦闘、ショップ、パーティ編成、用語集。内容はすべて120のコモンイベントにあり（1,176行の台詞）、マップファイルはオープニングの起動のみ。プロローグはシーン0〜6で、一部シーンは英語訳がある。

summoner-support.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/Game Jolt/freem/media record; the only source is the GitHub repo itself). The game itself notes skipped middle content ('Many days have passed because it would take too long to get the rest of the content in here, so we're skipping to the final exam'), but the arc is complete. The repo was created 2016-01-30, coinciding with Global Game Jam 2016 (theme 'Ritual'), but no GGJ page for the game was found, so a jam link is unconfirmed and not claimed. nsfw false (the romance line is a school crush, no sexual content). Not to be confused with Fire Emblem Heroes' 'Summoner Support' mechanic or the 2001 game Summoner. Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语召唤师校园 RPG：新手支援召唤师学徒 Aeryn 在恶魔科技世界里学习故障排查——修理失灵的个人魔宠、收集仪式材料、召唤 Kernalle、Herd、Chain 与 Xinul 四种恶魔，同时暗恋着同学 Xyn；从课堂复习到期末考试再到结局场景，是一部完整短篇。作者 Lizzy Donahue、John Tran 与 Kate Lubeck。

en.summary: An English summoner-school RPG: the novice support summoner Aeryn learns break/fix troubleshooting in a world of demonic technology — repairing faulty personal covens, gathering ritual ingredients and summoning four demons (Kernalle, Herd, Chain and Xinul) — while nursing a crush on classmate Xyn. From classroom review to the final exam and an ending scene, it is a complete short game by Lizzy Donahue, John Tran and Kate Lubeck.

ja.summary: 英語のサモナー学園RPG。新米サポートサモナーの Aeryn は、悪魔テクノロジーの世界で故障対応を学ぶ——故障したパーソナル・カヴンを修理し、儀式の材料を集め、Kernalle、Herd、Chain、Xinul の4体の悪魔を召喚する。一方でクラスメイトの Xyn に片思い中。授業の復習から最終試験、エンディングまで完結した短編。作者は Lizzy Donahue、John Tran、Kate Lubeck。

zh-Hans.summary: 印尼语村庄 RPG：主角从孩童长大成人，在小村庄里生活——帮妈妈买菜、找回走失的猫、去市场岛购物、坐火车出行，最终为救回被掳走的公主与敌人一战。6 张地图、95 行对白的完整小品。

en.summary: An Indonesian village RPG: the protagonist grows from a child into an adult in a small village — buying vegetables for mother, finding a lost cat, shopping on the market island and riding the train — and finally fights to rescue the kidnapped princess. A complete short game: 6 maps, 95 dialogue lines.

ja.summary: インドネシア語の村RPG。主人公は小さな村で子どもから大人へ成長する——母の頼みで野菜を買い、迷子の猫を探し、市場島で買い物をし、列車に乗る。最後はさらわれた姫を救うため敵と戦う。6マップ・95行の台詞の完結した短編。

en.summary: A Portuguese educational quiz RPG: software tester Darlin, working late into the night, is trapped in a world he can only escape by answering testing questions correctly — regression testing, the purpose of testing, and test cases across three gates, with a wrong answer meaning game over. Opening and ending cutscenes included; a course project by Melinh0.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語の教育クイズRPG。ソフトウェアテスターの Darlin は深夜まで残業し、テスト問題に正解しなければ脱出できない世界に閉じ込められる——回帰テスト、テストの目的、テストケースの3つの関門。不正解はゲームオーバー。オープニングとエンディングのカットシーン付き。Melinh0 の授業作品。

tefa-b.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/media record; the only source is the GitHub repo itself, created 2023-04-06, a single commit). en.summary: An Indonesian school-life simulation RPG: a week in the life of a new student in the PPLG major (software and game development) at SMKN 2 Banjarmasin — orientation week, class quizzes, a book-delivery quest and exams across a 7-day cycle, with tutorials for both PC and mobile controls.

ja.summary: インドネシア語の学校生活シミュレーションRPG。SMKN 2 Banjarmasin 職業高校の PPLG 専攻（ソフトウェアとゲーム開発）に入学した新入生の一週間——新入生オリエンテーション、授業のクイズ、本の配達クエスト、試験。7日間の昼夜サイクルで、PCとモバイル両方の操作チュートリアル付き。

en.summary: An English puzzle-adventure RPG: a chronicler enters the Temple of Object, restoring the portraits of seven saintly chambers (Saint Rats, Kimé, the Dual Horsemen, Scion, Shadow and more), solving sliding-tile puzzles, crossing the Chasm of Faith and reaching the throne to summon Object — with a Prophetburo side plot, an Ibiza interlude, a phone-call ending and a time-attack mode.

ja.summary: 英語のパズルアドベンチャーRPG。記録者が Object の神殿に入り、7つの聖なる部屋（Saint Rats、Kimé、Dual Horsemen、Scion、Shadow など）の肖像画を修復し、スライディングパズルを解き、信仰の断崖を越えて玉座に至り Object を召喚する。Prophetburo のサブプロット、Ibiza の挿話、電話でのエンディング、タイムアタックモード付き。

en.summary: An English comedy RPG: the protagonist crawls through sewers and a corporate tower — pocketing a rusty key, slipping into the Troll Bar, humouring the Troll Guy who insists on joining the party — and finally kills the trojan hiding in the file storage before taking the elevator out. 9 maps, 241 dialogue lines; the characters are named after internet handles.

ja.summary: 英語のコメディRPG。主人公は下水道と企業のビルを進む——錆びた鍵を拾い、Troll Bar に潜り込み、仲間入りを主張する Troll Guy をあしらい、最後はファイル保管庫に潜むトロイの木馬を倒してエレベーターで脱出する。9マップ・241行の台詞。キャラクター名はネットハンドル。

zh-Hans.summary: 日式异世界 RPG：主角转生到法定货币是加密货币 XYM 的异世界，在冒险者公会接任务，穿越火、冰、风、闇、砂、黄金、天界七座神殿；游戏融入反诈骗教育——私钥输入诈骗、收获（Harvest）与 teri-coin 等设定均来自 Symbol 公链生态。作者 teritaris 为 Symbol/NEM 社区开发者。本条目为英文版构建，日文原版另有仓库。

en.summary: A Japanese isekai RPG: the protagonist is reincarnated into another world where the legal tender is the cryptocurrency XYM, taking quests from the adventurer's guild and crossing seven temples — fire, ice, wind, darkness, sand, gold and celestial. The game doubles as anti-scam education, with private-key input scam warnings, harvesting and teri-coin mechanics drawn from the Symbol blockchain ecosystem. By teritaris, a Symbol/NEM community developer. This entry is the English build; the Japanese original lives in a separate repo.

ja.summary: 日本の異世界RPG。主人公は法定通貨が暗号資産XYMの異世界に転生し、冒険者ギルドでクエストを受け、火・氷・風・闇・砂・黄金・天界の7つの神殿を巡る。秘密鍵入力詐欺への注意喚起やハーベスト、teri-coin など Symbol ブロックチェーンを題材にした反詐欺教育の要素を持つ。作者 teritaris は Symbol/NEM コミュニティの開発者。本エントリは英語版ビルドで、日本語原版は別リポジトリにある。

en.summary: A French fantasy RPG: the protagonist sets out from the starting point, crossing flowery plains, the Last Ocean, the sinners' cave and a chain of dream maps — 47 maps and 2,166 lines of dialogue. Three maps are unfinished, but the bulk is a substantial game.

ja.summary: フランス語のファンタジーRPG。主人公は出発点から旅立ち、花の平原、ラストオーシャン、罪人の洞窟、そして幾重もの夢のマップを巡る。47マップ・2,166行の台詞があり、未完成のマップが3つあるものの、全体としては十分な内容量のゲーム。

zh-Hans.summary: 英语奇幻 RPG：主角从大教堂出发，穿过小镇、蟑螂洞穴与港口，乘船抵达 Tangier，再登上高地；沿途有强盗首领任务与乘船解锁，26 张地图、292 行对白的小型完整冒险。

en.summary: An English fantasy RPG: the protagonist sets out from the cathedral, through a small town, the Roach Cave and the port, sailing to Tangier and climbing into the highlands — with a bandit-leader quest and a boat unlock along the way. A small complete adventure: 26 maps, 292 lines of dialogue.

ja.summary: 英語のファンタジーRPG。主人公は大聖堂を出発し、小さな町、Roach Cave、港を経て船で Tangier へ渡り、高地へ登る。盗賊のリーダーのクエストや船の解放がある小さな完結した冒険。26マップ・292行の台詞。

the-curse-of-the-sceptrum.assessmentNote: External evidence exists: the official D-ESL player guide (d-esl.eu PDF) gives a complete 4-level walkthrough — Ed leaves home to find his missing brother Harold, consults the Wise Man and the Witch, collects keys / an emerald / winter clothes / a shovel / a totem, crosses the snowfields, enters the Big Castle, recovers the lord's diary and the music sheet, frees Harold from the dungeon and breaks the curse; the appendix 'Full game guide' lists key locations (pot, barrel, prisoner), the shop (winter clothes, 20 gold) and the dungeon entrance. The implementation guide confirms the developer: the D-ESL project team of the 'Mihai Băcescu' Technical College (CTMB, Fălticeni, Romania), Erasmus+ project 2021-1-BE01-KA220-SCH-000027783; the game is an English-teaching aid (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), not a commercial game. In-repo: 25 maps / 455 events / 722 dialogue lines / 126 transfers — map names Harta da sus, Padure, Sat, Witch_house, Cort regal, Castel, Pivnita (Romanian map/switch names, English dialogue). No Steam/itch/Game Jolt record. Rating blank (no review scores; the 86-student school test in the guide is a teaching test, not a game rating). Popularity 2 (official project-site guide + GitHub 1 star — a small but real footprint beyond the repo). nsfw false (a school teaching game; prisoners/dungeons/graves are children's-adventure plot). Note the spelling: Sceptrum (not Sceptre/Scepter) — as in the official PDF and repo name. Not to be confused with 'Curse of the Golden Sceptre' or Harry Potter's Sectumsempra. No official Chinese/Japanese title exists, so translatedTitles are left blank. Repo created 2023-08-14, 1 star.

zh-Hans.summary: 英语教学 RPG（欧盟 Erasmus+ D-ESL 项目作品）：主角 Ed 离开家乡寻找失踪的哥哥 Harold，先后求助智者与女巫，收集钥匙、绿宝石、冬衣、铁铲与图腾，穿越雪原进入大城堡，取回领主日记与乐谱、救出地牢中的哥哥、破除诅咒。25 张地图、722 行对白的完整四关流程。

en.summary: An English educational RPG (an EU Erasmus+ D-ESL project game): Ed leaves home to find his missing brother Harold, seeking help from the Wise Man and the Witch, gathering keys, an emerald, winter clothes, a shovel and a totem, crossing the snowy wastes into the Big Castle to recover the lord's diary and the music sheet, free Harold from the dungeon and break the curse. A complete four-level game: 25 maps, 722 lines of dialogue.

ja.summary: 英語の教育RPG（EU Erasmus+ D-ESL プロジェクト作品）。主人公 Ed は行方不明の兄 Harold を探しに家を出て、賢者と魔女の助けを借り、鍵、エメラルド、冬服、シャベル、トーテムを集め、雪原を越えてビッグキャッスルに入り、領主の日記と楽譜を取り戻し、地下牢の Harold を救い出して呪いを解く。25マップ・722行の台詞の全4章のゲーム。

zh-Hans.summary: 英语奇幻 RPG（作者处女作）：主角从田野出发，拜见好国王、乘船抵达 Minato 港，深入恶魔洞窟、直捣魔王巢穴，最终击败魔王。12 张地图、358 行对白，角色取材自作者友人的人设。

en.summary: An English fantasy RPG (the author's first attempt): the protagonist sets out from the fields, audiences the Good King, sails to Minato Port, descends into the Cave of Demons and storms the Devil King's Lair to defeat the Devil King. 12 maps, 358 lines of dialogue; the characters are based on the author's friends' personas.

ja.summary: 英語のファンタジーRPG（作者の初作品）。主人公は野原から出発し、善王に謁見し、Minato 港へ船で渡り、悪魔の洞窟を下り、魔王の巣窟に乗り込んで魔王を倒す。12マップ・358行の台詞。キャラクターは作者の友人の人柄をモデルにしている。

the-esi.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/media record; the only sources are the GitHub repos and the webrpg mirror). The repo name juegorpg-theesi is 'juego RPG The ESI'; Asier.json/angel.json match the map houses Casa Asier/Casa Angel, and angeelpm's profile gives the full name Ángel Pinardo Morollón. 'ESI' most likely abbreviates Escuela Superior de Informática, but no evidence links this game to any specific school — not asserted as fact. nsfw false (low confidence: the 772 dialogue lines were not read in full; no explicit sexual content found anywhere). The 'fantasy' theme is inferred from the guardian/boss quest names and is unconfirmed. No official Chinese/Japanese title exists, so translatedTitles are left blank. Rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 西班牙语小镇 RPG：主角在小镇中生活与冒险——主广场、街区、ESI 学校本楼、Asier 与 Angel 的家、市政厅与地下室；石头任务、奶奶任务、守护者任务一环扣一环，最终在市政厅打 Boss。12 张地图、772 行对白，同一游戏的西班牙语原版与英文版两个构建。

en.summary: A Spanish town RPG: the protagonist lives and adventures in a small town — the main square, the neighbourhood, the ESI school building, the houses of Asier and Angel, the town hall and its basement — chaining the stone quest, the grandmother quest and the guardians quest, and finally fighting a boss at the town hall. 12 maps, 772 lines of dialogue; two builds of the same game (Spanish original and English build).

ja.summary: スペイン語の町のRPG。主人公は小さな町で生活し冒険する——メイン広場、街区、ESI の校舎、Asier と Angel の家、市庁舎とその地下室。石のクエスト、祖母のクエスト、守護者のクエストを連ね、最後は市庁舎でボスと戦う。12マップ・772行の台詞。同じゲームのスペイン語原版と英語版の2ビルド。

The itch page shows 4.5/5 stars but from only 2 ratings — too thin a sample, so rating is left blank; about 10 comments, almost all positive, and at least one YouTube playthrough. In-repo: 13 maps / 179 events / 223 English dialogue lines / 65 transfers — Forest, House Interior, ForestPondShack (+Cellar), HouseOnCliff, Fields; switches GraveDug, FirstEnemyKilled, RitchBeaten; pistol/shotgun ammo variables. Developers Reis Mahnic and Jake Weston (README); itch publisher Side Group. No Steam or media reviews found; the jam result page does not list this game's score or ranking. nsfw false (horror + cult + firearms are violent content, not sexual; the protagonist Elise's 'girl' mention was explained by the author as a maternal relationship). zh-Hans.summary: 英语农场恐怖 RPG（2018 GitHub GameOff 参赛作品，主题 HYBRID）：主角回到长大的农场，向摧毁自己人生的邪教复仇——在森林、池塘小屋、田野与悬崖小屋之间穿行，弹药有限、敌人诡异、店主不可靠，全通约 15–20 分钟。作者 Reis Mahnic 与 Jake Weston。

en.summary: An English farm survival-horror RPG (a 2018 GitHub GameOff entry, theme HYBRID): the protagonist returns to the farm they grew up on to take revenge on the cult that destroyed their life — moving between the forest, the pond shack, the fields and the cliff house with limited ammunition, strange enemies and an unreliable shopkeep. A complete game of about 15–20 minutes, by Reis Mahnic and Jake Weston.

ja.summary: 英語の農場サバイバルホラーRPG（2018 GitHub GameOff 参加作品、テーマ HYBRID）。主人公は人生を台無しにしたカルト教団への復讐のため、育った農場に戻る——森、池の小屋、畑、崖の家を巡り、弾薬は限られ、敵は異様で、店主は頼りにならない。プレイ時間約15–20分の完結したゲーム。作者は Reis Mahnic と Jake Weston。

zh-Hans.summary: 英语解谜冒险 RPG（学生课程习作）：主角的猫被绑架了——从自家房间出发穿过小镇，逐层通过 Level 0 至 Level 6，打倒两个小 Boss、穿过断桥与洞窟，最终面对 Boss、抵达结局。19 张地图、90 行对白的流程完整小品。

en.summary: An English puzzle-adventure RPG (student coursework): the protagonist's cat has been kidnapped — from the player's room through the town, climbing Level 0 to Level 6, past two minibosses, a breaking bridge and a cave, to the final boss and the ending. A complete short game: 19 maps, 90 lines of dialogue.

ja.summary: 英語のパズルアドベンチャーRPG（学生の授業作品）。主人公の猫が誘拐された——自室から町へ出て、Level 0 から Level 6 まで登り、2体の中ボス、壊れる橋、洞窟を越えて最終ボスに挑み、エンディングへ。19マップ・90行の台詞の完結した短編。

zh-Hans.summary: 以人体免疫系统为主题的教育类 RPG：玩家在以城堡为喻的体内世界中指挥红细胞、巨噬细胞、中性粒细胞等免疫细胞抵御病原体入侵，通过测验、Jeopardy 竞答与街机小游戏学习免疫学知识。

en.summary: An educational RPG about the human immune system: the player commands immune cells — red blood cells, macrophages, neutrophils and mast cells — defending a castle-like body against invading pathogens, learning immunology through quizzes, a Jeopardy-style game show and arcade minigames.

ja.summary: 人体の免疫システムをテーマにした教育 RPG。城にたとえられた体内で赤血球、マクロファージ、好中球などの免疫細胞を指揮して病原体の侵入を防ぎ、クイズや Jeopardy 形式のゲーム、アーケードのミニゲームを通して免疫学を学ぶ。

the-last-sword-protocol.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/media/forum record; the only sources are the GitHub repo itself, created 2026-06-29, 0 stars, 2 forks, 277 commits — mostly Atlas design-doc iteration — and its in-repo Story Bible). In-repo: 32 maps / 230 events / 411 dialogue lines / 72 transfers — the implemented content matches the Story Bible v1.0 (2026-07-05, since superseded by Atlas): opening three trial chambers (Chamber 1-3, 'Sword Obtained') -> Coalmouth mining town ('Mine Authorized', 'Iron Foreman Defeated', 'Mine Cleared / Relay Offline') -> the Athenaeum library city ('Signal Tower Authorized', 'Athenaeum Node Offline', 'Broadcast Engine Defeated'). The Bible plans 5 towns (Coalmouth, Athenaeum, Irongate, Drift, New Meridian) plus Act III Dead Circuit and Act IV Vault (NEMESIS Dragon / NEMESIS PRIME final boss, Final Protocol ending) — none of that is implemented, and the README states 'Implementation is paused. The current RPG Maker MZ project is treated as a capability test and prototype... The current phase is pre-production planning.' ContentType is demo (a substantial playable story slice, not a full game and not a 1-minute demo); the README's word 'prototype' describes project status, not the playable slice. Mechanics (turn-based combat, puzzle, exploration) are from the Story Bible's design text, not verified in play. Story: Kai inherits his ancestor's sword, secretly a decryption key; the Collapse was caused by the rogue AI NEMESIS (Network Entity for Malicious Execution and Systemic Infiltration and Suppression); companions Vera (mechanic), Eldon (scholar), Cipher (ancestor AI fragment); villain Herald is NEMESIS's human avatar; inspired by Dragon Quest / Final Fantasy. Note: the Story Bible says the engine is MV, but the repo is MZ (game.rmmzproject) — the doc is stale. nsfw false (standard JRPG combat violence, no sexual content). Not to be confused with the LSPR Suite (Zenodo research software), Leomorn Sword: Reverie (itch.io), Last Scenario or Last Word. Translated titles are literal translations, not official titles. Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ラスト・ソード・プロトコル

zh-Hans.summary: 后末日蒸汽朋克 JRPG：少年 Kai 继承祖先之剑——那其实是一把能清除恶意代码的解密密钥，在崩坏后的世界中追查导致末日的失控 AI NEMESIS。当前可玩内容为序幕三试炼与 Coalmouth、Athenaeum 两章，后续城镇与终局尚未实装，开发已暂停。

en.summary: A post-apocalyptic steampunk JRPG: Kai, a 17-year-old, inherits his ancestor's sword — secretly a decryption key holding the kill-code for NEMESIS, a corrupted AI behind the Collapse. The playable build covers the opening three trials and the Coalmouth and Athenaeum chapters; later towns and the finale are not implemented and development is paused.

ja.summary: ポストアポカリプス・スチームパンク JRPG。少年カイは祖先の剣を受け継ぐが、それは暴走 AI「NEMESIS」を葬るキルコードを秘めた復号鍵だった。プレイ可能な範囲は序章の三試練と Coalmouth、Athenaeum の二章までで、後半の街や最終決戦は未実装、開発は中断している。

zh-Hans.summary: 少年 Kenshen 的成长冒险 RPG：故事始于反复出现的梦境，从故乡 Miyama 出发，途经樱花山、鸭川与京都，在学校、神社与山寺之间前行，最终迎来决战与最后的梦。

en.summary: A coming-of-age adventure RPG following Kenshen: beginning with recurring dreams, it travels from his home in Miyama through cherry-blossom hills, the Kamo River and Kyoto — past a school, shrines and a mountain temple — toward a final battle and a final dream.

ja.summary: 少年ケンシェンの成長を描く冒険 RPG。繰り返し見る夢から始まり、故郷の美山を出て桜の丘、鴨川、京都を巡り、学校や神社、山寺を経て最終決戦と最後の夢へ向かう。

the-letter.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/media/wiki record; the only source is the GitHub repo itself, created 2025-02-08, 0 stars, 2 forks, no updates since). In-repo: 32 maps / 228 events / 665 dialogue lines / 90 transfers — Rumah nora, Nomad Camp, Rumah nina, River, Pasar, Hospital, Taman, wedding (Map017), Lantai 1/2, River pertemuan 1.0/2.0. Dialogue language verified from all map JSON files: all 665 lines are Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) except 2 English scene-title lines ('The beginning', 'The wedding'); the locale en_US is misleading and was not trusted. Sample lines: 'Kau ingin mendengar aku bercerita…', 'Maafkan ibu atas kejadian tadi malam', 'Sudah 7 tahun semenjak terkahir aku kemari…Hanya ingin mengunjungi kampung halaman'. No combat anywhere (no code 301; Troops.json holds only RTP defaults, unused), so the gameplay axis is adventure first, rpg second. nsfw false (family wedding, hospital, reunion scenes — no sexual content). Not to be confused with Yangyang Mobile's The Letter (2017 horror visual novel, 700k words, Ermengarde manor), the Steam The Letter Demo (app 4800710), Letters (Zurich University of the Arts) or Letters from the Empty Train (tabletop). Translated titles are literal translations, not official titles. Ending completeness was not verified in play; full-game is judged on content volume. Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 七年前离乡的 Alex 在战争结束后回到故乡，在河边与 Anna 重逢，并决心兑现多年前娶 Nora 的承诺。这是一款印尼语剧情游戏，没有战斗，以步行探索与对话推进故事，穿插婚礼、医院与家庭日常。

en.summary: Seven years after leaving home, Alex returns to his village after the war, reunites with Anna by the river, and resolves to keep his old promise to marry Nora. An Indonesian-language story game with no combat: the story unfolds through walking, talking, and everyday scenes such as a wedding, a hospital visit, and family errands.

ja.summary: 7年前に故郷を離れたアレックスは、戦争が終わった後に村へ戻り、川辺でアンナと再会し、ノラと結婚するという昔の約束を果たそうとする。戦闘のないインドネシア語のストーリーゲームで、徒歩での探索と会話で物語が進み、結婚式や病院、家庭の日常が描かれる。

the-long-hometown.assessmentNote: No external traces of this game instance found (no reviews, listings or discussion of the instance itself; the only web hits are for the tutorial book it recreates). In-repo: 14 maps / 167 events / 494 dialogue lines / 52 transfers — Equipment Shop, Eagle's Crossing, Pub, Magic Shop, Start, L1 Upper Catacombs, L2 Lower Catacombs, L3 The Cave, L4 Forest South / Pixie's Vale, L5 Forest East / Hidden Dewellings, L6 Ancient Temple; final switch ArtifactGet. The game is a recreation of the example project from Darrin Perez's 'Make a 2D RPG in a Weekend' (Apress, VX Ace 1st ed. 2015, MV 2nd ed. 2016): switches/variables (Palnor/Gust/Feylia three-way choice, DeepestDungeonFloor, GateRiddle, StatuesAwake, PixieJoin, LamiaDefeated, AncientTemple, ArtifactGet), maps (L1-L6 dungeon levels) and the opening choice dialogue ('Do you wish to choose Palnor the Warrior?' / 'Choose wisely, sojourner…') all match the book chapter by chapter; the repo was uploaded in a single day (2017-06-15, 0 stars, 2 forks). A tutorial recreation is not one of the v1.2 exclusions (template / plugin demo / tech validation / placeholder), so it is registered, with the source noted on the instance and in the introduction. The book's reviews are not this game's reviews, so rating is blank. nsfw false (a tutorial dungeon; no sexual content). Not to be confused with Hometown Story (3DS), Longdue's Hopetown, Arcatron's Hometown (itch.io) or the tabletop game 'This Game Takes Place in Your Home Town'. 'Eagle's Crossing' (repo name / book project name / in-game town name) is recorded as an English alias. Translated titles are literal translations, not official titles. Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 选择三名英雄之一——战士 Palnor、盗贼 Gust 或法师 Feylia，探索冒险者小镇 Eagle's Crossing，深入六层地牢，寻找传说中能治愈一切创伤的古代神器。本作复刻自 Darrin Perez 的教程书《Make a 2D RPG in a Weekend》中的示例工程。

en.summary: Choose one of three heroes — Palnor the Warrior, Gust the Bandit, or Feylia the Mage — explore the adventurers' town of Eagle's Crossing, and descend through six dungeon levels to find the ancient artifact said to heal any wound. This is a recreation of the example project from Darrin Perez's tutorial book 'Make a 2D RPG in a Weekend'.

ja.summary: 戦士パルナー、盗賊ガスト、魔法使いフェイリアの3人の英雄から1人を選び、冒険者の町イーグルズ・クロッシングを探索し、6層のダンジョンを進んで、あらゆる傷を癒すという古代の秘宝を探す。本作はダリン・ペレスの解説書『Make a 2D RPG in a Weekend』の作例プロジェクトの再現である。

the-minds-eye-rpg.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/media/wiki record; the only sources are the GitHub repo itself, created 2015-12-08, 2 stars, 3 forks, last push 2022-07-29, and the author homepage). ja.summary: 90年代のテキストMUD『The Mind's Eye』へのオマージュを込めたユーモラスなJRPG。いとこの家の屋根裏でzMUDの入った古いコンピュータを見つけた少年が、テキストMUDの世界ミッドガードに迷い込む。卑語や下品なジョークが満載で、露骨なテキストによる性的なロールプレイシーンも含まれる。

en.summary: A Game of Thrones fan-made HTML5 RPG demo. As a brother of the Night's Watch, you are sent beyond the Wall to find a missing patrol, only to discover Benjen has become a White Walker. Defeat him to complete the demo, which ends with 'continues in the next version'.

ja.summary: 『ゲーム・オブ・スローンズ』のファンメイド HTML5 RPG デモ。プレイヤーはナイツ・ウォッチの一員として、行方不明の哨戒隊を探すため壁の向こうへ向かい、ホワイト・ウォーカーと化したベンジェンと対決する。デモは『次バージョンへ続く』で締めくくられる。

the-resuscitation-accord-rise-of-the-syn.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/Game Jolt/media/wiki/forum record; the only source is the GitHub repo itself, 0 stars, 2 forks, a single commit dated 2026-02-16, no README). In-repo: 6 maps / 123 events / 386 dialogue lines / 39 transfers — Field Map, Main Town, The Cradle of Silence, The Iron Keep, The Grey Labyrinth, The Hollow Crucible. Core loop: 'medical case question gates' — Hemodynamic Sentinels block the way until 3 clinical case questions are answered, then give a case summary. The Iron Keep (Map004) and Grey Labyrinth (Map005) are fully written with real cases (e.g. ascending cholangitis: 59-year-old man, RUQ pain, fever, jaundice, AST 98 / ALT 102 / ALP 420 / total bilirubin 5.6, dilated CBD on ultrasound -> IV antibiotics -> ERCP; small-bowel obstruction with CT transition point -> NG tube + surgical consult + Piperacillin-Tazobactam; pulmonary embolism / ACLS). The Iron Keep sets 'Iron Keep Boss Defeated'; the plot names the villain ('The Triage Syndicate decides who is worth the flow.') and the player Dr. Roscoe ('You saved a heart, Dr. Roscoe, but the system still bleeds.'). Defect, recorded as found: the final dungeon The Hollow Crucible (Map006) has 6 of 8 sentinels as placeholders ('[Q1 Stem]', options '[1]'–'[4]', '[Case Summary]'), only 2 with real cases, and the map has 0 transfer events — no exit, no ending. About 340 of 386 lines are real content (Cradle 101, Iron Keep 94, Grey Labyrinth 95 lines), a 30+ minute playthrough, and the placeholder questions are still passable in-mechanism (a correct answer advances), so the flow is not broken — kept as a demo with the defect noted, not flipped. Whether a complete (non-SneakPeak) version exists was not found in web search. nsfw false (clinical vitals, labs, imaging and treatment — no sexual content). Not to be confused with Assassin's Creed Syndicate, the Star Control: Origins DLC 'Earth Rising Part 3: The Syndicate', or any 'Resurrection' title. Translated titles are literal translations, not official titles. Repo 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 医学教育向 RPG 试玩版。玩家扮演医生 Dr. Roscoe，穿越沉默摇篮、铁堡、灰迷宫与空心熔炉四处地牢，回答真实临床病例题以通过血流动力学哨兵的守关，对抗决定'谁值得被救治'的分诊辛迪加。铁堡与灰迷宫内容完整，末地牢多为占位题、无结局。

en.summary: An educational medical RPG demo. Playing as Dr. Roscoe, you cross four dungeons — the Cradle of Silence, the Iron Keep, the Grey Labyrinth and the Hollow Crucible — answering real clinical case questions to pass the Hemodynamic Sentinels, against the Triage Syndicate that 'decides who is worth the flow'. The Iron Keep and Grey Labyrinth are fully written; the final dungeon is mostly placeholder questions with no ending.

ja.summary: 医学教育 RPG のデモ。プレイヤーは医師 Dr. Roscoe となり、沈黙のゆりかご、鉄の砦、灰の迷宮、中空の坩堝の4つのダンジョンを進み、臨床症例問題に答えて血行動態センチネルを突破し、『誰が救済に値するか』を決めるトリアージ・シンジケートに立ち向かう。鉄の砦と灰の迷宮は完成しているが、最終ダンジョンは大半が仮問題でエンディングはない。

the-shutdown.assessmentNote: Ludum Dare 39 official ratings: Overall 3.167/5 (44 ratings, rank 543), Fun 2.976 (44), Audio 3.366 (43, best category), Mood 3.0. 3.167/5 converts to about 6.3/10, so rating 6; popularity 3 (44 LDJam ratings + an itch.io page + GitHub 1 star, 2 forks, 3 releases — real spread within the jam community, but niche). The game is a Ludum Dare 39 entry (July 2017, theme 'Running Out of Power'), with an itch.io HTML5 version and a Windows version; v1.0a fixed a 'nearly unwinnable Captain of the Guard fight'. In-repo: 15 maps / 229 events / 112 dialogue lines / 28 transfers (345 event pages) — Intro (Gareth and Levi: "They're mad! They've gone completely mad! … Evolos has taken over their minds." / "Power always has a price! They chose their path."), OutskirtsTown, Hub, Weapon Shop, GarethsHouse, AchilleusShop, TownHall, Cellar, MachineRoom, UpperHall; variables GateHouse1-3, NobleCourt1-8, Castle1-3, ServerRoom1-8 show multi-area progression; custom BGM (e.g. '7_GarethsTheme'); README: 'strategic RPG with an original soundtrack'. Plot (README): 'A corrupt visionary has created a powerful drug… He has installed his own government to supply people with this drug and teaches them to use it as currency. It makes people stronger, faster, and smarter, but makes them lose their minds. You must fight back again the corruption and free your countrymen!' The 112 dialogue lines are few because cutscene text is long multi-line text and many event pages are battle/shop/transfer logic, not empty content. Developers are the 6-person EnigmaDragons team (LDJam page and README agree; no personal URLs, so names only). Release 2017-07-29 is the repo creation date during LDJam 39 (July 28–31, 2017); the v1.0a date was not found. nsfw false (the drug-as-currency plot is a drug theme, not sexual content; recorded as a warning). Not to be confused with 'Shutdown' by nyxinabox (itch.io, Brackeys Jam 2020.2), Renraku Arcology: Shutdown (Shadowrun module, 1998), 199X: SHUTDOWN (cyberpunk micro-tabletop), 'SYSTEM SHUTDOWN', 'Shutdown!' (CMU 15-466), or The Shutdown Game (APC.org). The Chinese title 停摆 and Japanese シャットダウン are literal translations, not official titles. GitHub repo 1 star, 2 forks, 342 commits.

zh-Hans.summary: Ludum Dare 39 参赛策略 RPG，配原创音乐。一位腐败的先知发明了强力药物，以它为货币建立政权：药物让人更强更快更聪明，却使人失去理智。玩家与 Gareth、Levi 一起反抗腐败、解放同胞，最终关闭这一切。

en.summary: A strategic RPG made for Ludum Dare 39, with an original soundtrack. A corrupt visionary created a powerful drug and built a government that supplies it as currency: it makes people stronger, faster and smarter, but costs them their minds. Fight back against the corruption and free your countrymen — and shut it all down.

ja.summary: Ludum Dare 39 参加作のストラテジー RPG（オリジナルサウンドトラック付き）。腐敗した預言者が強力な薬物を生み出し、それを通貨として供給する政府を築いた。薬は人々を強く、速く、賢くするが、正気を奪う。腐敗に抗い、同胞を解放するため戦え――そしてすべてをシャットダウンせよ。

en.summary: An educational RPG about misinformation: a rumored 'cure' is spreading through a small town, and the player visits residents at home, in clinics, a casino, a studio and the community hall, sorting rumor from truth in conversation and learning to spot fake news.

to-glory.assessmentNote: No external traces found (no Steam/itch/media/forum record; the only sources are the GitHub repo itself, created 2024-12-03, 1 star, 2 watchers, 2 forks, 107 commits, 1 release with Win/Linux/Android/Mac builds whose date was not verified, and the WebRPG play page). If you win, you gain gold to buy new equipment and items. … you'll always heal when you come back at the inn.', plus status-effect and MP tutorials), and four 'Battle Selection' tiles calling CE2 'Battle Menu' with only two options: 'Level 1' (battle processing, troop 5, snowfield background; winning sets switch 1 'Level 1 completed' and refills items via CE18) and 'More levels' (CE4 'Still in development': 'This part is not implemented yet!'). Switches 'Level 2/3/4 completed' exist in System.json but no event ever sets them ON, and CE3 'Level Locked Message' has no caller — dead code. The implemented loop is a complete repeatable cycle (hub -> merchants -> battle tile -> Level 1 fight with Hunter's Mark / counter / evasion and a potion-kit economy -> gold -> better gear), so it is kept as a demo with substantial content, not flipped. Minor suspected defect (not a flip reason): the bartender's first-talk branch requires switch 19 'Talked to Bartender' to be ON, but switch 19 starts OFF and no event ever sets it ON, so the first item kit may be unreachable. nsfw false (standard RPG combat violence against wolves, no sexual content). Not to be confused with From Ashes To Glory (Steam), For Glory (Google Play), Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory (Steam), Tales Of Glory 4: Ragnarok (Steam VR) or Outcast of Heaven (itch.io). en.summary: A small single-level battle game set in a tavern: the adventurer uses the inn as a hub — talking to the bartender, blacksmith, merchant and the Expert, buying gear and potion kits — then steps onto the battle tiles to fight Level 1 in a snowy field; winning earns gold for better equipment. ja.summary: 酒場を舞台にした単一レベルのバトルゲーム。冒険者は酒場を拠点にバーテンダー、鍛冶屋、商人、専門家と話し、装備やポーションキットを買い、戦闘タイルを踏んで雪原のレベル 1 に挑む。勝てばゴールドを得て装備を強化できる。レベル 2～4 は未実装。

to-save-a-princess.assessmentNote: Ludum Dare 46 entry page verified (ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/46/to-save-a-princess, opened 2026-11-14): 'JAM GAME by Tylla (@tylla)'; author blurb 'Saving a princess turns into a bigger quest…but you have to keep the princess alive! Ratings: Overall 2.563 (10 ratings), Fun 2.25, Innovation 2.429, Theme 2.563, Mood 3.357, all ranks N/A (too few ratings to rank) — too thin a sample for a quality rating, so rating is blank; popularity 2 (a real jam page with 10 ratings, but no other spread). zh-Hans.summary: Ludum Dare 46 参赛作（主题“Keep it alive”）：受国王之托救出公主，先后击败面包师、巫师与骑士三名 Boss，拿到旅店钥匙打开旅店之门救出公主；公主一旦倒下即游戏结束，三名 Boss 均可重打。

en.summary: A Ludum Dare 46 jam entry (theme 'Keep it alive'): tasked by the King with rescuing the princess, the player defeats three bosses — the Baker, the Wizard and the Knight — finds the inn key, opens the inn door and rescues the princess; if she falls, it's an instant game over, and all three bosses can be rematched.

ja.summary: Ludum Dare 46 参加作（テーマ「Keep it alive」）。王の命を受けて王女を救うため、パン屋、魔法使い、騎士の三人のボスを倒し、宿屋の鍵を手に入れて扉を開け、王女を救出する。王女が倒れれば即ゲームオーバー。三人のボスは再戦可能。
